**Location**
------------


Leeds**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


We are currently looking for a **Senior Developer (SQ Web)** to join our **Technology and Service Operations** Function within the **Digital and Technology Group**.


This is a **full\-time** opportunity, on a **permanent** basis. The role will be based in 7/8 Wellington Place, Leeds, LS1 4AP.


Government departments and agencies are working towards implementing a minimum 60% attendance in office sites.

  

We are currently implementing a flexible, hybrid way of working, with a minimum of 8 days per month working on site to enable the collaboration and contact with partners and stakeholders needed to deliver MHRA business. Attendance on site is driven by business needs so depending on the nature of the role, this can flex up to 12 days a month, with the remainder of time worked either remotely or in the office. Some roles will need to be on site more regularly. Remote working is potentially available for some specific roles. Please discuss this with the recruiting manager before accepting an appointment.

  

### **Job description**

**Who are we?**


The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.


The MHRA Digital and Technology Group (DTG) exists to help protect and improve public health by enabling the Agency to become a modern, intelligence\-led regulator.


We bring together digital, data, technology, cyber security and artificial intelligence expertise to deliver services, platforms and insights that support the regulation of medicines, medical devices and healthcare technologies across the UK.


Our work goes beyond traditional IT. We design and deliver user\-centred services, harness trusted data, apply advanced analytics and responsible AI, and build secure, resilient digital foundations that help the MHRA make better decisions, work more effectively and respond to a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape.


By joining DTG, you'll help shape the future of regulation while delivering technology that makes a real difference to public health.


The Technology \& Service Operations (TSO) function is responsible for managing the existing IT infrastructure including both software and hardware, databases, and other technology platforms; leading the support and maintenance of applications; development and testing of new applications and platforms; and cyber and information security for the Agency.


The Engineering team, made up of software developers, DevOps engineers, Quality Assurance testers, and data professionals (including engineers, scientists, and visualization experts), is tasked with the creation of applications and services, ensuring quality for both new and existing agency offerings, and developing data visualizations through their expertise in data engineering and science.

### **Person specification**

**Role Purpose**


This Senior Developer role implements web applications and guides the ways in which the team works and provide technical leadership, to deliver cloud native web\-based solutions to our end users. The post holder will be proficient in a wide range of technical systems and be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written and will contribute to the developer community and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice.


The post holder will work in cross\-functional product squads on the design and development of creating cloud native (Azure), JavaScript based microservices (node.js) and front end (react) utilising agile (SAFe), paired programming, TDD and DevOps.

 **Key responsibilities and results areas**

* As an experienced voice in the technical team, you will steer implementation and code design decisions for contingent labour and service providers
* Mentoring more junior members of your team to develop and maintain high\-performance, scalable solutions
* Assist in leading the design and development of site/software projects following best practices, as well as regular status reporting
* Assist in leading in optimising, debugging, and enhancing existing software whilst preventing regression in live systems
* You must have solid JavaScript coding skills, experience of TDD/BDD (jest, enzyme, cucumber, gherkin), be collaborative (Jira, Confluence, GitHub)
* You will establish good engineering practices and have strong ability with Open Source, Cloud First, Microservices and DevOps principles and its associated technology like React, Next.js, Node.js, Rust, Azure services (AKS, CosmosDB, Blob Storage, Functions), Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contribute to a collaborative, dynamic planning process \- prioritising the work that needs to be done against the capacity and capability of the team ensuring the smooth and successful development of sites/software.
### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Developing Self and Others
* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture
* Communicating and Influencing


We only ask for evidence of these behaviours on your application form:

* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture
### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* You will hold a Computer Science or similar engineering degree, ideally hold a post\-graduate qualification, or equivalent industry experience.
* You will ideally hold certifications with a major cloud provider (preferably in Azure) and as a microservice based full stack JavaScript developer.
* You will have previous experience as a developer working in a DDaT environment working on workstreams specific to the regulation of medicines/devices data and its subsequent caseworking.
* Substantial experience with certain tools and associated engineering processes.
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £42,410, Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency contributes £12,286 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .* Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave on entry, rising by one day for each completed year of service to a maximum of 30 days and pro\-rata for part\-time staff. PLUS 8 bank holidays
* Privilege Leave: 1 day
* Hours of Work: 37 hours (net) per week for full time staff in all geographical locations, including London and pro rata for part\-time staff
* Occupational Sick Pay (OSP): One month full pay/one month half pay on entry, rising by one month for each completed year of service to a maximum of six months full pay and six months half pay after five years service.
* Mobility: Mobility clause in contracts allowing staff to be mobile across the Civil Service
* Civil Service Pension Scheme. Please see the link for further information http://www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk/ For enquiries relating to the Civil Service Pension Schemes please contact MyCSP's Pension Service Centre directly on 0300 123 6666
* Flexible working to ensure staff maintain a healthy work\-life balance
* Interest free season ticket loan or bike loan
* Employee Assistance Services and access to the Civil Service Benevolent Fund
* Eligibility to join Motoring , Boundless by CSMA
* Variety of staff and Civil Service clubs
* On\-going learning and development
**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**


This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths, Experience and Technical skills.**Key dates** (dates are indicative only and could be subject to change)

* Closing date  11 October 2026 at 23:55
* Sifting  from 16 October 2026
* Main panel interviews  from 26 October 2026


Communications will be electronic via email therefore it is important that you check your Civil Service Jobs account regularly, as well as your spam/junk email folder.


Were committed to being diverse and inclusive, so please make your application anonymous by removing all identifying personal information (such as names and dates) from your employment history and personal statement.

**What will the process look like?**

**1\. Sift Stage**


The main sift, where we'll read and score the rest of your application. This may involve a large number of applications, please bear with us as this can take some time.

* **Anonymised CV** which sets out your career history, previous experience and skills, highlighting specific responsibilities that are relevant for this role.
* **Personal statement:** Write a 500 word personal statement where you demonstrate how you meet the technical skills required for this role, providing examples to evidence your level of skill. In your personal statement we are looking for evidence of how you meet the role criteria and person specification. Your personal statement should aim to make use of the full wordcount and show how you meet the above criteria. Please give clear and specific examples of what you have done personally and the impact it has had.
* **Online application form**, including questions based on the Behaviour, Experience and Technical Success Profiles. Please ensure all application questions are completed in full; your application may not be considered if any responses are left blank.


The panel will look at your application and are looking for evidence of the stated points. We may raise the benchmark score required if we receive a high number of applications.

**2\. Main Panel Interview**


Successful candidates from the sift stage will be invited to attend an interview. We use a blended interview technique, allowing us to find out more about you. We use the Success Profile framework and at interview we will be assessing Behaviours and Experience.


Your interview will include:

At interview, we will be asking questions relating to the following:

* Behaviours, as listed in the person specification
* Experience, as listed in the person specification

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview.


If you require any disability related adjustments at any point during the process, please contact careers@mhra.gov.uk as soon as possible.


Candidates will be subject to UK immigration requirements as well as Civil Service nationality rules. Further information on whether you are able to apply is available here.

Any move to the MHRA from another employer will mean you can no longer access childcare vouchers. This includes moves between government departments. You may however be eligible for other government schemes, including Tax\-Free Childcare. Determine your eligibility here.


Individuals appointed on level transfer will retain their existing salary and are responsible for ensuring they fully understand the financial implications of any potential move and the impact (if any) on their terms. If an individual is in any doubt, they should seek clarification before accepting a job offer.


Staff joining on promotion will receive up to a 10% increase of their current basic salary, or the pay band minimum, whichever is the greater.

Successful candidates may be subject to annual Occupational Health reviews dependent on role requirements. If you have any queries, please contact careers@mhra.gov.uk.

  

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.### **Security**

* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre\-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
* individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020

Further information on nationality requirements
### **Working for the Civil Service**

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles .
The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.
The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.### **Diversity and Inclusion**


The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy .**Apply and further information**

jobs.description:
PHP Developer (12\-Month Fixed Term Contract)




**Location:** Hybrid  

**Salary:** Up to £60,000 per annum  

**Contract:** 12\-Month Fixed Term Contract




Join Focus Group and Help Build the Future of Our Internal Platforms


At Focus Group, we're looking for a talented and passionate **PHP Developer** to join our Technology team on a 12\-month fixed\-term contract. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in developing and enhancing a portfolio of business\-critical applications that support our continued growth and innovation.




Working alongside a collaborative team of developers, QA specialists, and technology professionals, you'll be responsible for building new functionality, improving existing systems, and helping deliver high\-quality software solutions that make a real impact across the business.




What You'll Be Doing


* Developing new features, enhancements, and bug fixes across our bespoke CMS and CRM platforms.
* Writing robust, maintainable code and comprehensive unit tests.
* Collaborating with QA teams to ensure solutions meet acceptance criteria and quality standards.
* Supporting development\-related issues through a rotating support desk function.
* Participating in Agile ceremonies including daily stand\-ups, planning sessions, and team meetings.
* Contributing to a variety of technology projects across the business.
* Working closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.




What We're Looking For


Essential Skills \& Experience


* Proven experience in a PHP Developer or similar software development role.
* Strong experience with **Laravel**.
* Solid understanding of **JavaScript**, **jQuery**, and **Vue.js**.
* Experience working with **SQL databases**, ideally MariaDB or MySQL.
* Strong HTML5, CSS, and Bootstrap skills.
* Experience developing and consuming APIs, with knowledge of tools such as Postman.
* Good understanding of unit testing and software quality practices.
* Experience using Git and version control workflows.
* Strong knowledge of the software development lifecycle.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively within a team.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a passion for delivering quality solutions.




Desirable Skills


* Experience within Telecoms, MSP, ICT, or similar industries.
* Exposure to CRM and CMS platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based development environments.
* Understanding of secure development principles and best practices.
* Experience with .NET technologies.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
* Awareness of AI technologies and integrations, including Microsoft Copilot, LLMs, and AI\-driven automation solutions.




Why Join Focus Group?


At Focus Group, technology is at the heart of what we do. You'll join a supportive, ambitious team where your ideas are valued, your development is encouraged, and your work has a genuine impact on the business. This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, utilise modern technologies, and be part of an organisation that is continually evolving.

jobs.title: Engineering Operations Coordinator – Maternity Leave Cover
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Humanscale is the premier designer and manufacturer of ergonomic products that improve health and comfort at work. **We have a focus on sustainability with over 70% of our products currently certified as having a Net Positive impact on the environment.** Our award\-winning office products – seating, sit/stand desks, technology support and lighting – have led the industry in performance and simplicity for over 40 years.
Overview:

This is temporary cover / fixed\-term contract role to cover maternity leave.  

The role of UK Engineering Operations Coordinator is an administration position whose main role is to organise and assist the Engineers in the department to have the correct parts and information to carry out their customer visits.  

Second to this is dealing directly with our customers and Dealer partners from a customer support point of view. Making sure they are happy with their Humanscale products and if not to assist them with replacement parts orders or booking in our engineers to carry out any repairs.
Responsibilities:
* Manage and coordinate the UK Support mailbox, ensuring all enquiries are handled efficiently and prioritised appropriately.
* Provide timely, professional, and high\-quality customer service, responding to client and customer enquiries promptly.
* Generate quotations based on engineering audit reports.
* Generate quotations based on customers repair and warranty enquiries.
* Submit customer, warranty, and warehouse stock orders to the Dublin Customer Service team.
* Create and manage defect reports for quality issues relating to Humanscale products.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with Humanscale furniture dealers, partners, and key accounts.
* Maintain the UK Support engineering repair log, ensuring daily repair jobs are accurately recorded and tracked.
* Prepare and issue weekly customer invoices for completed chargeable work, while proactively supporting initiatives to improve financial performance and reduce outstanding balances.
* Schedule and coordinate engineers’ visits, ensuring all work is planned, communicated, and executed efficiently for customers and the engineering team.
* Provide operational support to the Sales team, advising on warranty claims and engineering\-related enquiries.
* Promote effective teamwork within the department, ensuring deadlines are achieved and operational processes run efficiently.
* Support projects from initiation through to completion, ensuring milestones, deadlines, and customer satisfaction objectives are consistently met.
* Attend regular operational, progress, and management meetings to provide updates and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational matters, resolving issues effectively and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day business operations.


Qualifications:
* Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent prioritization and time\-management skills.
* Professional and confident communication with customers, dealers, partners and key accounts.
* High attention to detail is a must
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, complex environment
* Experience of Microsoft Office including Excel and prior experience of internal order management systems is an advantage

 **Humanscale is an equal opportunities employer**
Please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.humanscale.com/about/legal\-information/privacy\-policy.cfm

**Passionate people create exceptional things**

Did you know that the solutions we develop are a key part of most industries? Electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more.

* Design, implement, and maintain automated test cases primarily using Python and C\# to ensure comprehensive test coverage across software components.

* Extensive experience with Python and C\# programming languages, including a solid understanding of object\-oriented programming principles.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps and TeamCity, including pipeline integration and test execution management.
* Demonstrated ability to develop software for cross\-platform environments, with expertise in Windows and Linux systems; knowledge of Linux systems is highly advantageous.

* Experience documenting software architecture using industry\-standard design patterns and best practices to facilitate maintainability and knowledge transfer.

* Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies, ideally with practical experience in Scrum and/or Kanban frameworks.
* Proficient in source control management using tools such as Git and Azure DevOps repositories.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills enabling collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Experience developing and managing CI/CD pipelines is essential to ensure smooth integration and deployment cycles.

* Lifelong learning and career growth

**Why Join Phoebus?**

These acknowledgements remain meaningful to us, as they were driven by the commitment and feedback of our colleagues.


From our ambitious growth plans and modern tech stack to our culture of support, innovation, and well\-being, PSL offers an environment where you can thrive, make an impact, and build a career you’re excited about.

Our contemporary Solihull office sits right in the heart of the town, just steps away from Touchwood Shopping Centre’s shops, cafés, and restaurants—perfect for lunch breaks or post\-work plans. jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer (Azure) - Cardiff
jobs.description:
**Internal Information**
------------------------

Location: Cardiff


Grade: C1/C2


SC Clearance Eligibility required


**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------

You will design, build and ship agentic AI applications on Microsoft Azure for clients in regulated and high\-governance sectors. This is a hands\-on engineering role in a product\-aligned team: you will take a solution from first design through to live production, and then keep it running.  



We work across Retail, Utilities, Manufacturing, Transport, Health and the Public Sector, so you will pick up new domains quickly and often.  



* A multi\-agent case\-handling assistant for a public sector client, retrieving from several legacy systems of record, with full audit trails and human\-in\-the\-loop approval on every outbound decision.
* A document\-intelligence pipeline for a utilities client that extracts structured data from tens of thousands of scanned engineering records, with automated groundedness and accuracy evaluation gating each release.
* An internal developer platform capability that lets a retail client's own engineers deploy evaluated, guardrailed agents against their product data without going through us each time.
**Your Role**
-------------

Delivery and technical leadership


* Act as a trusted technical voice for architects, product owners and client stakeholders, turning business problems into agentic AI solution designs.
* Own solutions across the full lifecycle, from design through to production support.
* Explain technical trade\-offs and AI risk and value clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Reflect compliance and audit requirements in technical delivery decisions when working in regulated client environments.
Mentor and pair with less experienced colleagues.  
* 
Engineering


* Build and deploy agentic AI applications and multi\-agent systems on Azure using Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry) and the Azure AI Services portfolio, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence.
* Develop production\-grade AI\-enabled services and APIs in Python and C\#/.NET, integrating agents and models with enterprise applications and data sources.
* Apply prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation and agent orchestration patterns to build reliable, tool\-using workflows.
* Implement guardrails, content safety, evaluation, monitoring and governance for generative and agentic solutions.
* Integrate with Azure\-native services (Functions, Container Apps, AKS, API Management) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Support LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation, deployment pipelines and observability for AI workloads in production.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

* Production experience building LLM\-based applications on Azure that went live and that you then supported, rather than proofs of concept that stopped at demo.
* Strong production coding in Python and/or C\#/.NET, including building and integrating APIs and backend services.
* Practical depth in retrieval\-augmented generation: chunking and embedding strategy, retrieval tuning, and evaluating the groundedness and accuracy of outputs in a live system.
Client\-facing delivery experience, comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and able to explain technical trade\-offs to people who are not engineers.  
* 

We use all of the following. You are not expected to arrive with them, and where you do not have them we will help you develop them.


* Breadth across agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen) so you can make an informed call on which fits a use case rather than defaulting to the one you know.
* Judgement on the model landscape: selecting between proprietary and open\-weight models on cost, latency and quality, and revisiting that as the landscape shifts.
* Multi\-agent systems and tool\-calling and function\-calling patterns.
* Containerisation and orchestration for AI workloads at scale (Docker, AKS).
* Vector search at scale (Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB vector search).
* LLMOps and MLOps tooling and automated evaluation harnesses.
* Data privacy, security and compliance for AI systems, including responsible AI standards and GDPR considerations.
* Delivery in regulated and high\-governance environments.
**We are a Disability Confident Employer**
------------------------------------------

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
  

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


* Declare they have a disability, and


* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.


**Your security clearance and pre\-employment checks**
------------------------------------------------------

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance .


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.


**Make it real – what does it mean for you?**
---------------------------------------------

We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation. At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud.

  

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024\. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
  

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

  

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.


**Why you should consider Capgemini**
-------------------------------------

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free\-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET and Azure)
jobs.description:
**Internal Information**
------------------------

Location: UK Wide


Grade: B2\-C2


SC Clearance Eligibility required


**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------

You will build and run enterprise\-scale custom software on Azure for clients in regulated and high\-governance sectors. Hands\-on .NET engineering, distributed systems, Kubernetes and the reliability work that keeps them healthy in production, in teams that own what they ship.


We work across Retail, Utilities, Manufacturing, Transport, Health and the Public Sector, so you will pick up new domains quickly and often.  



Examples of what you will actually be building


* Application modernisation/re\-platforming a utilities client's billing integration layer from a monolith onto event\-driven .NET microservices on AKS, with no customer\-facing downtime during cutover.
* Designing and running the API platform behind a public sector service handling several million transactions a month, including the service\-level objectives, observability and incident process that go with it.
* Building the internal developer platform and deployment pipelines a retail client's own engineering teams use day to day, so they can release safely without a hand\-off to us.
**Your Role**
-------------

Delivery and technical leadership


* Act as an engineer and subject matter expert on client delivery engagements, owning specification, development, testing and implementation of complex cloud native applications on Azure.
* Lead and mentor development teams and raise the engineering standard around you.
* Shape delivery practice across projects: branching strategy, testing approach, CI/CD and release pipelines.
Engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders on the client side.  
* 
Engineering


* Design and document Azure cloud native solutions, incorporating recommended security practices, and contribute to architectural decisions.
* Build resilient, scalable APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and contribute to integration\-led transformations and platforms.
* Containerise workloads with Docker and orchestrate with Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Define and automate infrastructure as code using Bicep or Terraform, and build out CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Support services before they go live through design consulting, platform and framework development, automated testing, release pipelines, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Keep services healthy once live: availability, latency, errors, saturation and traffic, instrumented with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry and Log Analytics.
* Apply secure cloud native design principles: identity\-first, encryption, least privilege and zero trust.
* Scale systems sustainably through automation, and reduce toil rather than absorbing it.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

These six things are the bar. If you can evidence them, we want to talk to you.


* Strong production .NET engineering (C\#, .NET 8 or later), with a working command of SOLID, software design patterns and test\-driven development.
* End\-to\-end delivery of Azure PaaS solutions that went live and that you then supported.
* Modernisation of legacy applications to cloud native Azure using AI assisted tooling, e.g. GitHub Copilot
* Containerisation and orchestration in production with Docker and Kubernetes, ideally AKS.
* CI/CD and infrastructure as code in anger: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and Bicep or Terraform.
Experience delivering in collaborative agile teams in a commercial, client\-facing environment.  
* 
What we will help you build  



We use all of the following. You are not expected to arrive with them, and where you do not have them we will help you develop them.


* Domain Driven Design, microservice architecture, CQRS and event sourcing.
* Site reliability practice: service\-level objectives, error budgets, distributed tracing and incident response.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Digital)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

  

At Aberdeen, our ambition is to be the UK’s leading Wealth \& Investments group.

  

Strengthening talent and culture is one of our strategic priorities. We strive to make Aberdeen a great place to work so that we can attract and retain the industry’s best talent.

  

Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society.

  

We are focused on growing our direct and advised wealth platforms and repositioning our specialist asset management business to meet client demand. We are committed to providing excellent client service, supported by leading technology and talent.

  

Aberdeen comprises three businesses, interactive investor (ii), Investments, and Adviser, each of which focuses on meeting and adapting to our clients’ evolving needs:

  

* interactive investor, the UK’s second largest direct\-to\-consumer investment platform, enables individuals in the UK to plan, save, and invest in the way that works for them.
* Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers.
* Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes.

 **About the Department**


The Digital Engineering team designs, builds and evolves the digital platforms that power Aberdeen’s public websites and digital services. Working closely with Product Owners, Architects, UX specialists and business stakeholders, the team delivers secure, scalable and client\-focused solutions that support Aberdeen’s strategic ambitions. Collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence are central to how the team works, helping to enable our clients to be better investors.

 **About the Role**


As a Senior Full\-Stack Engineer (Digital), you will play a leading role in building and enhancing modern digital platforms using React, Next.js, .NET and Microsoft Azure. You will work across front\-end applications, backend services, cloud infrastructure and enterprise integrations, contributing to technical design, architecture and engineering standards while remaining hands\-on in delivery. This is an opportunity to influence technology modernisation, mentor fellow engineers and improve digital experiences used by clients and customers. Based in Edinburgh, you will help drive innovation, resilience and operational excellence while continuing to develop your own expertise and career.  



  

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain modern web applications, APIs and digital integrations that deliver secure, scalable and high\-performing client experiences.
* Lead technical design decisions, influence architecture and ensure alignment with engineering, security and accessibility standards.
* Drive cloud\-native development within Microsoft Azure, including CI/CD automation, observability and operational excellence.
* Collaborate across product, UX, architecture and business teams to deliver high\-quality digital solutions and technology modernisation initiatives.
* Investigate complex production issues, lead root cause analysis and continuously improve platform resilience and service performance.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering capability, reusable platform services and cross\-team improvement initiatives.

 **About the Candidate**

* Strong proficiency in React and Next.js for modern web application development.
* Experience building and supporting REST APIs and backend services using C\# and .NET.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud\-native services and identity integrations.
* Knowledge of Git, GitHub Actions, automation tooling and modern software delivery practices.
* Strong understanding of accessibility, SEO, security, performance optimisation and SQL.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving and mentoring skills with a collaborative mindset.

 **Desirable criteria**: Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, Sitecore XM Cloud, Vercel, Playwright, Storybook, GraphQL, Marketing Cloud, Aprimo, Seismic, Sitecore Search, CodeQL, SonarQube and experience of enterprise\-scale digital platforms.

  

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process.

 **Our benefits**

  

There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.


When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance\-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits here.

 **Our business**

  

Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do here.

 **An inclusive way of working**

  

Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you.


At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face\-to\-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business.

  

An inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. If you need assistance with your application, or a reasonable adjustment to your interview arrangements – for example, because you are neurodivergent, or have a physical, sensory, cognitive, mental, visible or invisible disability – please let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

**We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace where all forms of difference are valued and which is free from any form of unfair or unlawful treatment. We define diversity in its broadest sense – this includes but is not limited to our diversity of educational and professional backgrounds, experience, cognitive and neurodiversity, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or belief and ethnicity and geographical provenance. We support a culture that values meritocracy, fairness and transparency and welcomes enquiries from everyone.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**If you need assistance or an adjustment due to a disability please let us know as part of your application and we will assist.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Location**

Coventry, West Midlands (England), CV1 2WT : Nottingham, East Midlands (England), NG2 1AW : Plymouth, South West England, PL6 5WS**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


It is an exciting time to be joining HM Land Registry (HMLR) as we continue to deliver the ambition set out in our Business Strategy through our transformation portfolio, and as a Senior Enterprise Architect you will play a critical role in ensuring our technology strategy is developed, embedded and followed.


The Architecture Practice sits within the Transformation and Technology directorate and is responsible for developing the strategy and roadmap of technology within HMLR. Architecture roles within the practice are primarily grouped under three specialisms, Enterprise, Technical and Security, with this role sitting within the Enterprise specialism.


Our enterprise architects work across capabilities and are leaders that support the organisation to make informed business decisions, serving as a driving force for the delivery of transformation and technology initiatives. Working with a range of stakeholders to solve complex enterprise business problems and translate strategy into delivery whilst ensuring the long\-term sustainability of the organisations technology estate.

**Open Session**

If you would like to find out more about the role, the Architecture profession and what its like to work at HMLR, a Hiring Manager Q\&A session where you can virtually 'meet the team' will be held via MS Teams on **Tuesday 13th October 2026\.**


Book your virtual seat:


https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hm\-land\-registry\-senior\-enterprise\-architect\-hiring\-manager\-qa\-tickets\-2002049867046?aff\=oddtdtcreator


Check out the video below to find out what it is like working in Digital Careers at HM Land Registry.

### **Job description**


As a Senior Enterprise Architect, you will provide strategic architectural direction, impact analysis and assurance by understanding the organisations ecosystem and its interdependencies, aligning technology, information, people and processes.


You will network, communicate and advise stakeholders across domains, for example, Customer and Strategy, Service Delivery, Planning and Delivery, in identifying opportunities, influences or risks, guiding the organisation to make appropriate business, technology and data decisions by recommending reuse, sustainability and scalability to deliver maximum value.


You will provide decision support to the practice, directorate and wider organisation by driving forward our approach to managing, modelling and communicating architectural content.


You will also play an active part in the architecture practice and understand how to deliver our shared objectives to meet organisational goals by fostering, promoting and maturing enterprise architecture in HM Land Registry.


For more information about this role, please see attached Job Description.

### **Person specification**


To be successful in this role, you will be required to demonstrate the following criteria throughout the recruitment process.

**Essential technical Skills and qualifications:**

* Essential technical skills listed on the attached Job Description. *(Note: These skills are based upon the expected skills for a* *Senior Enterprise Architect* *role as defined on Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework.)*


Desirable:


There are no essential qualifications required, but evidence of the following will be beneficial:

* Architecture frameworks, for example, TOGAF or Zachman
* Modelling techniques ArchiMate, UML, C4 etc.
* ITIL Service Strategy, Service Design or equivalent

**Essential experience criteria:**

* An understanding of architectural domains (business, data, technology and security); with the ability to assess the impact of technical change on people, process, technology and data.
* Experience in communicating and/or modelling architectural domains to align strategic outcomes with technology, information, people and processes.
* Leading and influencing diverse groups to get to agreement on a technical solution.
* Experience in architecture governance and assurance processes, for example Design Authority.
* Understanding of the commercial impacts of technology implementation and adoption.
* Top\-down thinking and structured, logical decomposition of problems using appropriate modelling techniques and languages.
* Being comfortable with change and ability to multi\-task and prioritise work, being able to respond quickly to changing circumstances.
* Supporting or developing strategies, principles, patterns and roadmaps.


Please note that desirable criteria will not be assessed throughout the recruitment campaign.


For more information about the role, please see the attached Job Description and Candidate Pack.


HMLR expect everyone to spend at least 60% of their working time in the office.


This role will require regular travel to Plymouth and occasional travel to other offices, external supplier sites and other Government Departments.

**Visa Sponsorship**


Please note that we will only offer sponsorship for a skilled worker visa where a role is in a certain business critical category. This role does not meet that category, and we will not sponsor a skilled worker visa.


You must ensure you have the appropriate right to work in the UK before applying.

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Making Effective Decisions
* Working Together
* Communicating and Influencing

------------


Alongside your salary of £59,057, HM Land Registry contributes £17,108 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .

They are the foundation of all we have achieved and all we aspire to in the future. We want our people to feel proud to work for HM Land Registry and able to fulfil their full potential.

You can find more information on our rewards package on our website.

---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. jobs.title: Cable Project Engineering Opportunities
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For these roles, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office \- Perth, Glasgow, Inverness or Aberdeen.


**Salary:** £36,200 \- £80,000 \+ car/car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.



Opportunities are available at the following levels, depending on skills and experience:


* **Assistant Engineer:** £36,200 \- £54,400
* **Engineer:** £51,600 \- £77,400
* **Senior Engineer:** £59,800 \- £80,000


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Fixed Term Contract \| Full Time \| Part Time \| Flexible First options available


**The roles**



SSEN Transmission has exciting opportunities for Assistant Cable Engineers, Cable Engineers and Senior Cable Engineers to join our growing engineering teams.



Whether you're at the beginning of your engineering journey or already an experienced engineer looking for your next challenge, you'll have the opportunity to help deliver the infrastructure that will enable the UK's transition to net zero.



As SSEN Transmission invests billions to upgrade the network and connect renewable generation across the UK, you'll work on some of the country's largest and most ambitious transmission and substation projects, helping to deliver a cleaner, more secure energy future.



Working across a diverse portfolio of transmission and substation projects operating at voltages up to 400kV, you'll contribute to the development and delivery of innovative engineering solutions that will power communities for generations to come.


**You will**


* Provide cable engineering support across multiple projects by producing or reviewing outline cable system designs during development phases, including review and assessment of technology options, underground cable routing selection, producing current rating calculations using CYMCAP software and assessment of interface requirements.
* Support the project life cycle, including design development, risk sessions such as HAZIDs, HAZCONs, HAZOPs, construction, installation, commissioning, and completion of complex projects. Collaborate with engineers and managers to identify and mitigate engineering and quality risks, support informed decision\-making, and conduct peer reviews of key issues.
* Develop technical scopes and specifications for new underground cable projects as well as modifications to existing assets.
* Review cable system prequalification and type testing reports in preparation for SSEN approval, reviewing and verifying contractor/consultant detailed underground cable system designs, witnessing factory and relevant discipline site acceptance testing.
* Promote and manage safety within your assigned projects through the implementation of CDM procedures and best practice, ensuring all engineering activities comply with relevant company, HSE and industry regulations.


**You have**


* A degree, HND or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, or significant relevant industry experience. Senior Engineers will ideally be a Chartered Engineer in a relevant institution or working towards chartered status.
* You will have demonstrable experience in transmission development, design and specification, with the ability to evaluate engineering challenges and work with others to identify effective technical solutions.
* To be successful in applying for this role, you will have experience working on the Transmission Network and a strong knowledge of High Voltage Cable systems.
* You will have an awareness of the legal and regulatory obligations for Transmission and be proactive in ensuring these are met to the highest standard. This includes a technical understanding of relevant legislation and the implications of this for Transmission network management for both Assets and Projects, including CDM \& ESQCR, is essential.
* Strong communication skills are essential, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to support decision\-making by senior stakeholders. You'll be confident working alongside key stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally, and building strong, lasting relationships.


We welcome applications from candidates both within and outside the electricity transmission industry. If you have transferable skills and experience from related sectors such as utilities, construction, infrastructure, energy, engineering or Industrial project delivery, we'd love to hear from you.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact shirley\-anne.o'connor@sse.com / 01738 351976 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

SSEN Transmission have exciting opportunities for varying Protection \& Control Project Engineering roles. Join our multi\-disciplined engineering team to help develop and deliver an expanding project portfolio to meet our Net Zero targets.

* Provide protection and control engineering support across multiple projects, by assessing and defining the technical scope requirements during development phases, before evaluating third\-party detailed designs as the project moves into delivery, predominantly panel and scheme designs.

* Support multi\-disciplinary project teams in identifying and managing engineering risks and identifying opportunities for the project to excel.
* Take responsibility for delivering required outputs to programme and participate in the development of our increasing digital design capabilities and scheme standardisation works.

* A minimum of HNC level qualification in Electrical Engineering.
* Demonstrable experience and skills in transmission protection and control application specification, panel and scheme design, as well as the skills to calculate protection settings for implementation. * The ability to demonstrate engineering diligence and the confidence to technically assess problems and critically assess a range of solutions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to support informed decision\-making by project and technical leaders.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
**Internal Information**
------------------------


Location: UK Wide


Grade: C1/C2


SC Clearance Eligibility required


**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------


ou will design, build and ship agentic AI applications on Microsoft Azure for clients in regulated and high\-governance sectors. This is a hands\-on engineering role in a product\-aligned team: you will take a solution from first design through to live production, and then keep it running.


We work across Retail, Utilities, Manufacturing, Transport, Health and the Public Sector, so you will pick up new domains quickly and often.


* A multi\-agent case\-handling assistant for a public sector client, retrieving from several legacy systems of record, with full audit trails and human\-in\-the\-loop approval on every outbound decision.
* A document\-intelligence pipeline for a utilities client that extracts structured data from tens of thousands of scanned engineering records, with automated groundedness and accuracy evaluation gating each release.
* An internal developer platform capability that lets a retail client's own engineers deploy evaluated, guardrailed agents against their product data without going through us each time.
**Your Role**
-------------


Delivery and technical leadership


* Act as a trusted technical voice for architects, product owners and client stakeholders, turning business problems into agentic AI solution designs.
* Own solutions across the full lifecycle, from design through to production support.
* Explain technical trade\-offs and AI risk and value clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Reflect compliance and audit requirements in technical delivery decisions when working in regulated client environments.
* Mentor and pair with less experienced colleagues.
Engineering


* Build and deploy agentic AI applications and multi\-agent systems on Azure using Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry) and the Azure AI Services portfolio, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence.
* Develop production\-grade AI\-enabled services and APIs in Python and C\#/.NET, integrating agents and models with enterprise applications and data sources.
* Apply prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation and agent orchestration patterns to build reliable, tool\-using workflows.
* Implement guardrails, content safety, evaluation, monitoring and governance for generative and agentic solutions.
* Integrate with Azure\-native services (Functions, Container Apps, AKS, API Management) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Support LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation, deployment pipelines and observability for AI workloads in production.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------


* Production experience building LLM\-based applications on Azure that went live and that you then supported, rather than proofs of concept that stopped at demo.
* Strong production coding in Python and/or C\#/.NET, including building and integrating APIs and backend services.
* Practical depth in retrieval\-augmented generation: chunking and embedding strategy, retrieval tuning, and evaluating the groundedness and accuracy of outputs in a live system.
* Client\-facing delivery experience, comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and able to explain technical trade\-offs to people who are not engineers.

We use all of the following. You are not expected to arrive with them, and where you do not have them we will help you develop them.


* Breadth across agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen) so you can make an informed call on which fits a use case rather than defaulting to the one you know.
* Judgement on the model landscape: selecting between proprietary and open\-weight models on cost, latency and quality, and revisiting that as the landscape shifts.
* Multi\-agent systems and tool\-calling and function\-calling patterns.
* Containerisation and orchestration for AI workloads at scale (Docker, AKS).
* Vector search at scale (Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB vector search).
* LLMOps and MLOps tooling and automated evaluation harnesses.
* Data privacy, security and compliance for AI systems, including responsible AI standards and GDPR considerations.
* Delivery in regulated and high\-governance environments.
**We are a Disability Confident Employer**
------------------------------------------


Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
  

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


* Declare they have a disability, and


* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.


**Your security clearance and pre\-employment checks**
------------------------------------------------------


To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.


**Make it real – what does it mean for you?**
---------------------------------------------


We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation. At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud.


You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024\. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
  

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.


**Why you should consider Capgemini**
-------------------------------------


Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free\-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

jobs.title: Assistant Editor (Master's/PhD holder) - Mechanical Engineering (Electronics)
jobs.description:
To strengthen our Editorial team, we are looking for recent PhD and Master's graduates who are eager to stay connected to scientific research by helping researchers worldwide publish their latest results. The position of **Assistant** **Editor** is an entry\-level, full\-time and permanent position based in our city centre office in Manchester, UK.  

  



**This is a full\-time, in\-office role** based in our Manchester city centre office, which is located next to Piccadilly Gardens in Manchester.


As **Assistant** **Editor** you will:

* Support the editorial process for academic research journals in your domain of expertise
* Organize peer review process for submitted manuscripts and coordinate editorial decisions
* Handle email communication between the parties involved in the publication process
* Collaborate with other members of the editorial team and production team
* Ensure that scholarly articles are accurately edited and published according to tight deadlines with a high degree of consistency

 **Requirements:**

* A PhD (preferred) or Master's degree in a field related to: **Electrical \& Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering / Computer Science**,**Telecommunication / Information Engineering**, **Automation \& Control Engineering**, **Microelectronics / Semiconductor Devices / Photonics, Mechatronics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering**, **Physics / Applied Physics**, **Materials Science**
* Excellent written and spoken English skills.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Team player with the capability to work in a dynamic, international environment.
* Detail oriented with the capacity to see the big picture.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Very good communication and coordination skills.


The career trajectory of this role includes work at conferences, visiting scholars, and marketing events work so applicants should be interested in working face\-to\-face with the scholarly community and be passionate about promoting open access.


As a successful candidate, you will receive full training in editorial work, working closely with Managing Editors and learning how to process research articles from submission to publication. Training supervised by an assigned tutor will take place on the job during the first six months. Depending on your background, you will be assigned to work on journals related to your field of study or research. No previous editorial experience is required; however, a familiarity with the academic editorial process is an advantage. This is a great opportunity to start a first job in a dynamic multinational company which offers a range of career development options to talented, enthusiastic, and hard\-working people.

  

If you are interested in this position, we look forward to receiving your application. We look forward to welcoming you to our Manchester office.

**What We Offer**


At MDPI, you will be joining an international team, working for the largest open\-access publisher in the world. Among the benefits of working for MDPI, you can expect:

* A competitive salary, including our quarterly bonus scheme, which rewards high\-performing editors.
* 10% pay rise after passing the six\-month probation period (for PhD holders, 5% for Master's Holders).
* Focused support from your group leader, who is your first point of contact for any issues.


	+ **Flexible Working Times**  
	
	You are able to start work anytime between 7\-9am, and finish between 3pm\-6pm.
	+ **Special Days Off**  
	
	Getting married or moving house? No need to use up your holidays, MDPI offer paid time off for such occasions.
	+ **Our Culture**  
	
	A friendly working environment with monthly lunch parties, office snacks and seasonal events.
	+ **Bonus Incentives**  
	
	Depending on your role, you may be eligible for one of our bonus schemes which rewards high\-performing employees.
	+ **Perkbox**  
	
	You will have access to our benefit platform called “Perkbox.” This will provide you with a range of discounts and benefits across various retailers, including savings on food, drinks, tech, travel, and more.
	+ **Health Cash Plan**  
	
	After passing probation, employees are enrolled into our private health membership with Bupa. You can claim money back on dental, doctors, and prescriptions amongst many other health services
	+ **Modern City Centre Office**  
	
	Located next to Piccadilly Gardens, our office is a 10 minute walk from both Manchester Piccadilly and Manchester Oxford Road train stations. There are also tram stops outside of the building.
	+ **Cyclescheme**  
	
	Save between 25\-39% on a bike and accessories.
	+ **Techscheme**  
	
	Save up to 10% on tax when purchasing tech equipment from places such as Ikea and Currys

**About MDPI**


A pioneer in scholarly open access publishing, MDPI has supported academic communities **since 1996**. Our mission is to foster open scientific exchange in all forms, across all disciplines. We operate more than **400 diverse, peer\-reviewed**, open access journals supported by over **66,000 academic editors**. We serve scholars from around the world to ensure the latest research is openly and broadly available.

**MDPI is headquartered in Switzerland with additional offices in Europe, Asia and North America.** We are committed to ensuring that high quality research is made available as quickly as possible. We also support sustainability projects, with sustainability as a key theme in many journals and through the MDPI Sustainability Foundation.

**Initiatives**

  

At MDPI, we develop and maintain various platforms in order to better serve the scientific community. Please find here\-below a list of our main platforms:


https://www.mdpi.com/


https://sciprofiles.com/


https://sciforum.net/


https://www.scilit.net/


https://www.preprints.org/


https://encyclopedia.pub/
