jobs.title: Programmer (Entry Level) – SQL & Data Programming
jobs.description:
**Role overview**


This is an entry\-level role for someone who wants to build a career in data programming and database development. Working primarily in Microsoft SQL Server, you will help load, process and maintain the data behind customer data platforms for a range of blue\-chip brands, making sure the information our clients rely on to give their customers relevant, personalised experiences is accurate, connected and delivered on time.


This role is based out of our London office with an expectation to be in the office at least 1 day per week.

**About Plinc**


Since 2001, Plinc has been helping big consumer brands boost their relevance, resonance and revenue. We’ve got a unique approach to connecting, analysing, and harnessing data that helps turn casual customers into consistent buyers.


We are a group of solutions\-focused data experts passionate about helping our clients achieve amazing things, whether it’s through expertly engineered data platforms or innovative analytics (such as machine learning and AI\-driven solutions) or strategic planning. We work with some of the world’s biggest and most respected brands and are at an exciting time in our evolution, with ambitious plans to scale our solutions and reach an even broader audience.


If you are looking for a role in a nurturing, fun, people\-focused environment and welcome the chance to test your skills working with super\-ambitious brands, then this is the opportunity for you. We invest in our people and promote personal development, offering training and support for growth and a range of employee benefits.

**What you'll be doing**


You will start with around a month of intensive, full\-time training in SQL and in the way we write and structure code, learning on a live client dataset so you understand what data we hold, how it joins together and the processes that run on it, alongside the other tools we use.

**By your second or third month you will be contributing to client work, which includes:**

* Running daily QA checks on data feeds and processes that load client data into our systems, then fixing issues or escalating them where needed
* Writing and maintaining SQL scripts and processes for data extraction, transformation and loading, including SSIS packages
* Integrating new data into customer data platforms, including our proprietarycloud\-based Unilyze platform and marketing tools such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Apteco FastStats
* Producing data extracts, reports and campaign selections to specification and to schedule
* Documenting data and workflow processes and suggesting improvements
* Building skills beyond SQL as you progress, including Azure, APIs and C\#

**Where it leads**


Programmers at Plinc learn a wide range of technical skills quickly and work on a constantly changing mix of clients and projects, within a supportive framework that still gives you room to put your own ideas forward. There may be future opportunities to move into **data engineering** and potentially become involved in the **development of our products/platforms.**

**About You**


You don’t need commercial SQL experience, as we will train you from the ground up. If you don’t have SQL, then you will need to have written code in another language (such as in Python, R or Java).


You will need to bring strong numeracy and a logical, analytical way of thinking. The bar is high, and so is the investment we make in the people who join us.

**What you’ll bring**

* Programming experience in any language, gained through study, personal projects or work; SQL is an advantage but not essential
* Excellent numeracy and a logical, analytical approach to solving problems
* Exceptional attention to detail and a methodical approach to checking your own work
* Clear, confident communication and a real appetite for working as part of a team
* A strong interest in technology and data, and the ability to pick up new skills quickly
* Not essential but highly beneficial \- a degree, or equivalent education/training/experience, in maths, science, engineering, computing or another numerate subject.

**And in return, Plinc offers**

* Salary: £30,000
* Bonus scheme
* 25 days’ annual leave, plus additional days with service
* Holiday Purchase Scheme – buy/sell up to 5 days
* 2 community volunteering days
* Hybrid working
* Flexible working practices
* Ongoing Training \& Development
* Health \& Wellbeing package
* Financial Health (pension, life assurance, etc.)
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Team \& Company Socials


Full details of local benefits and perks available on request from the People Team (HR).

**Why Join Us**


Our solutions and services help some of the leading brands in the UK solve the most complex marketing challenges, embracing the latest technological innovation to better connect, analyse and activate their data.


Part of the vibrant Savanta \& Next 15 Communications Group, we have an entrepreneurial and inclusive company culture that actively recognises and values its people, and offers unrivalled scope for career development, including mentoring, coaching and extensive training programmes.


Plinc is committed to being an equal opportunities employer and continuously strives to be an employer of choice. Our people are our greatest asset, we value workplace diversity and inclusion, oppose all forms of unlawful discrimination, and welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates of all backgrounds.


We encourage authentic responses that reflect your own experience and approach. Candidates should avoid relying on Generative AI to fully create cover letters or application responses, as this may be considered during the review process.


For information on how Plinc \& Savanta uses your data, please see https://savanta.com/about/careers/job\-opportunities

**All candidates will be considered equally; however, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship.**

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**



OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.



We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real\-time operational intelligence to strategic decision\-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions.



We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before.



We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit www.oag.com

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



OAG Digital is the team turning our world\-class data into a product\-led growth engine. A unified experience where customers can sign up, explore, and extract value on their own.



You'll work across two areas. Core is the platform backbone \- identity, auth, entitlements, billing, and the infrastructure everything else depends on. Intelligence is the layer above the data \- AI\-powered insights, predictive models built on Databricks and Snowflake, anomaly detection, and agentic features.



This is a full\-stack role. You'll own features from the data layer to the customer\-facing interface. We care about UX as much as throughput, and we're AI\-native \- tooling is part of how we develop, not an afterthought.

  

**This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we're unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.**


**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**


* Own features end\-to\-end \- from problem\-shaping with Product and Design through implementation, testing, production releases and future enhancements
* Build customer\-facing experiences and the backend systems and data models behind them
* Evolve platform architecture across Core and Intelligence for scalability, reliability, and sustainability
* Lead technical decisions and engineering strategy, balancing innovation with pragmatism
* Build core platform capabilities: auth, entitlements, billing integrations, and usage management
* Integrate AI models, data pipelines, and event\-driven systems on Databricks and Snowflake into the Intelligence layer
* Maintain the quality bar through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD
* Support junior and mid\-level engineers and help them grow
  


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Extensive full\-stack experience building and shipping production\-grade systems
* Strong front\-end skills (React, TypeScript, or equivalent) with genuine care for great web interfaces
* A builder's mindset. You understand the who and the why, and you own what ships.
* Strong C\# (or comparable OO language) and confidence across the full stack
* Solid system\-design knowledge (scalability, reliability, security) and the ability to defend architectural trade\-offs
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and DevOps practices
* Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases, and comfort working with data at scale
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead \- not just contribute to \- technical decisions
* Clear communicator who works directly with Product and Design and can shape problems as well as solve them
* AI\-native in how you develop \- you use AI tooling daily and expect the same from your team
  


**IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU ALSO HAD**


* Experience with Databricks or Snowflake, particularly in analytical or data\-intensive contexts
* Familiarity with AI/ML in production: model serving, prompt pipelines, or agentic patterns
* Experience with consumption\-based and subscription billing
* Experience with self\-serve billing platform integrations
* Exposure to aviation, travel, or data\-as\-a\-service businesses
* Experience standing up or significantly improving engineering foundations for a new product or team
* A portfolio showing you've raised the bar on UX, performance, or product craft


If you don't meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

  


**WE WILL OFFER YOU:**



 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day\-to\-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.



 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.



 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance



 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including private health insurance, a company bonus scheme and enhanced pension scheme



️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month


* Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme



 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year



 Annual learning and development budget.

  



OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.



We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description:
**Hybrid**Security, Enterprise Security


Warrington, England, United Kingdom  


**Description**
---------------


At the heart of everything we do is our vision to change lives every day, and our mission to grow The National Lottery responsibly and champion its impact.

  

We are Allwyn UK, part of the Allwyn Entertainment Group – a multi\-national lottery operator with a market\-leading presence across the USA (Michigan and Illinois) and Europe, including Czech Republic, Austria, Greece, Cyprus and Italy.

  

While the main contribution of The National Lottery to society is through the funds to good causes, at Allwyn we put our purpose and values at the heart of everything we do. Join us as we embark on a once\-in\-a\-lifetime, largescale transformation journey by creating a National Lottery that delivers more money to good causes.

  

We’ll talk a bit more about us further down the page, but for now – let’s talk about the role and who we’re looking for…

  

About the role


Working within the Enterprise Security team, you will provide specialist security architecture for customer\-facing and enterprise s across web, mobile, API and supporting cloud services. You will shape secure designs from discovery through delivery, translate risk into proportionate security requirements, and help engineering teams embed security throughout the software development lifecycle.

  

This is an architecture\-led role with practical security depth. You will not simply identify vulnerabilities: you will influence and platform design, define reusable patterns, guide security testing, support remediation decisions and provide clear risk advice to technical and business stakeholders.

  

What you’ll be doing


Provide security architecture support to mobile and web* initiatives from discovery and design through build, testing, release and operation.
* Partner with solution architects, software engineers, product teams, delivery leads and third parties to ensure security is designed in early without losing sight of pace, cost, usability and quality.
* Produce and maintain high\-level and detailed security designs, security requirements, architecture decisions, patterns and supporting assurance evidence.

Lead* threat modelling using structured techniques such as STRIDE, documenting threats, attack paths, trust boundaries, mitigations and residual risks.

Assess web s, native and cross\-platform mobile * s, APIs, microservices, identity flows, cloud services and third\-party integrations.
* Define security requirements for authentication, authorisation, session management, secrets, cryptography, data protection, API security, logging, monitoring, resilience and secure configuration.

Apply recognised* security guidance, including OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, OWASP MASVS and relevant secure\-by\-design principles.

Guide teams on secure mobile design, including secure storage, platform permissions, transport security, certificate handling, local data protection,* integrity and mobile backend/API controls.
* Guide teams on secure web design, including browser security controls, input and output handling, access control, session security, dependency risk and protection against common web attack classes.

Advise on security testing strategy, including SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, API testing, mobile* testing, IAST and penetration testing.
* Support the integration of proportionate security controls and automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, including the definition of quality gates and exception routes.
* Review security findings, challenge false positives where appropriate, prioritise remediation based on risk and support teams in agreeing pragmatic corrective actions.
* Produce penetration test scopes and security test plans, coordinate internal and external testing, and assess whether findings have been adequately remediated.
* Identify and communicate security risks, control gaps and non\-compliance clearly, supporting accountable owners to reach an informed risk position.
* Contribute to reusable security patterns, standards, guardrails and reference architectures for mobile, web and API delivery.
* Coach engineering and architecture communities on secure design, threat modelling and secure development practices.
  

What experience we’re looking for


Must Have:


Significant experience in* security architecture, product security or security engineering within an enterprise environment.

Security design experience across modern web s, mobile * s and APIs.
* Strong knowledge of common web, mobile and API threats and appropriate security controls.
* Practical experience of threat modelling and translating findings into clear, traceable security requirements.
* Good understanding of secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Agile delivery and CI/CD security.

Experience defining and interpreting* security testing, including SAST, DAST, SCA, API, mobile and penetration testing.

Knowledge of* identity and access management, including authentication, authorisation, federation, tokens and session security.
* Understanding of cloud\-native architecture, including containers, serverless services and microservices.
* Experience assessing data flows and defining controls for sensitive data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, pragmatic and risk\-based advice

Technical knowledge


* Web and API security, including HTTP/S, browser controls, CORS, CSP, REST and GraphQL.

iOS and Android security, including secure storage, permissions, deep links, transport security and* integrity.
* security tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube or equivalent.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

  

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  

  

*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  

  

*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  

  

*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*


As a Staff Engineer at Checkout.com, you will set the technical direction for systems that process payments at very high throughput, where correctness matters on every single transaction and has significant impact. This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade\-offs that come with it: latency budgets, failure domains, consistency guarantees, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock.  

  

You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams \- shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business\-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously.  

  

**How you'll make an impact**

* Own the architecture of high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems, defining the service boundaries, data models and integration patterns that let them scale by an order of magnitude
* Design for resilience from first principles \- redundancy, graceful degradation, backpressure, idempotency and recovery \- so that partial failures never become customer\-facing outages
* Set and defend the non\-functional requirements that matter: availability targets, latency percentiles, throughput ceilings, data durability and recovery objectives
* Lead the hardest technical decisions end to end, from problem framing and design review through to production rollout, migration and decommissioning of what came before
* Drive operational excellence by improving observability, alerting, capacity planning, load and chaos testing, and incident response, and by closing the loop on the root causes you find
* Raise the engineering bar across teams through design reviews, code review, pairing and mentorship, growing the senior engineers around you
* Partner with product, platform and other engineering teams to sequence delivery, remove blockers and keep multi\-team programmes aligned on a single technical direction
* Make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy and refactor\-versus\-rewrite calls, and communicate the reasoning and trade\-offs clearly to both engineers and senior leadership

 **Experience and qualifications**

* Significant experience building and operating distributed backend systems in production, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams
* Demonstrable experience designing for high throughput and low latency, and a strong intuition for where systems break under load
* Deep understanding of resilience patterns in distributed systems: idempotency, retries and backoff, circuit breaking, queueing and backpressure, consistency and failure modes
* Strong proficiency in either .NET or Java, and the ability to write clear, production\-ready code that others can maintain
* Experience with event\-driven and streaming architectures, and with relational and non\-relational data stores at scale
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based application development (we use AWS \& Azure), containers, orchestration and infrastructure as code
* Experience owning production systems on call, with a strong sense of ownership for observability, monitoring and incident response
* Experience leading complex migrations or re\-architectures of live, business\-critical systems with no loss of availability or data integrity
* Excellent communication skills, able to influence without authority, write clear design documents, and express technical trade\-offs to engineering and non\-technical audiences alike

 **Nice\-to\-haves**

* Experience in payments, financial services or another domain with strict correctness, auditability or regulatory requirements
* Experience with multi\-region or active\-active architectures, including data replication and failover strategies
* A history of mentoring engineers into senior and staff\-level roles

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**


We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.


Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.


We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.


It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**


We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.


Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.


For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Are you excited about building tools and services that help keep millions of customers safe while they enjoy their favorite music, audiobooks, and games? In this role, you'll work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding the problem, through design and implementation, to testing, deployment, and operations. You'll tackle problems where the business need is clear but the right technical solution still needs to be shaped, and you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how security scales across some of Amazon's most exciting entertainment products.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and maintain security tools, automations, and services that support ATG's media businesses, delivering working software across the full development lifecycle including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Collaborate with security engineers and partner engineering teams across Music, Audible, and Games to understand requirements and deliver solutions that address real security challenges.

A day in the life  

You might start your morning reviewing a pull request from a teammate, then shift into a design session where you and the security engineers map out the architecture for a new automation that reduces manual effort across the team. After lunch, you could spend focused time writing code for a service that integrates with partner systems in Music or Games. You'll regularly connect with stakeholders to understand their pain points and make sure what you're building solves the right problems. Expect a mix of heads\-down coding, collaborative problem\-solving, and operational support.  

  

About the team  

The ATG Security team is responsible for security across Amazon's media organizations, supporting businesses that include Music, Audible, and Games. Within this team, a small but growing development group builds the tools, automations, and security services that help these businesses operate safely at scale. This is a chance to join early and help shape the technical direction of that function.  

  

We value an inclusive team culture where everyone's perspective matters. jobs.description:
**Hey! Nice to see you!**


At Incubly, we believe that great people want to work with great people, so we started to build a company that attracts great minds and enables us to achieve great things while genuinely enjoying what we do. Our mission is to support tech companies and startups (scaleups) in scaling their teams quickly and with high quality, while boosting product development, testing, and deployment so we can succeed together.


We are currently working with a French company that is a leader in security and infrastructure solutions for cryptocurrencies and blockchain applications. It has a team of more than 400 professionals developing a variety of products and services to safeguard cryptocurrency assets, including worldwide leading hardware wallets.


As a **Platform Engineer,** you will work closely with product engineering teams to improve the developer experience and remove friction from the build, package, and deployment process. You will own and improve developer tooling, self\-service platforms, golden paths, runners, registries, delivery tooling, and observability. You will collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the platform is fast, reliable, secure, and easy to use, while using automation and strong systems thinking to help teams ship faster and more safely.
  

  

**Your daily responsibilities**


**CI/CD platform \& runner fleet**


* Own and evolve the self\-hosted GitHub Actions runner fleet, including Linux runners managed via Actions Runner Controller (ARC), self\-hosted macOS runners, and the Terraform modules that provision and scale self\-hosted infrastructure.
* Right\-size runner classes (CPU/memory/storage) against real workload profiles, balancing cost efficiency against engineering velocity, and supporting engineering teams in understanding and owning the resource footprint of their own jobs.
* Support the migration away from GitHub\-hosted runners, including evaluating trade\-offs between containerised and VM\-based execution for workloads with special hardware requirements (e.g. KVM access for Android emulators).
* Partner with embedded DevOps engineers on pipeline and dependency\-graph optimisations (build triggers, job fan\-out, monorepo change detection) to reduce queue times and unnecessary CI spend — you own the platform and runner layer these pipelines execute on.
* Investigate and resolve macOS virtualisation performance issues (e.g. Tart) and help evaluate alternative approaches such as remote simulator hosts.

**Artifact \& package management**


* Administer the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, Curation) as the organization’s primary artifact
  

repository, including repository structure, access control, vulnerability scanning policies, and
  

curation/allow\-listing of upstream dependencies.
* Provide light\-touch, minimal support for GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) and GitHub Packages where teams use them alongside JFrog.
* Operate and maintain ChartMuseum as the organization’s Helm chart repository, hosted on S3,
  

including storage lifecycle, access, and chart promotion workflows.
* Define and enforce container image ownership boundaries — platform\-owned hardened/minimal base images (e.g. Docker Hardened Images, Chainguard) versus engineering\-owned project extensions — and drive Dockerfile build and layer optimisation best practices across teams.

**Progressive delivery \& infrastructure automation**


* Operate two ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts environments, one serving internal tooling and one serving product workloads supporting GitOps\-based, progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) patterns for engineering teams.
* Author, maintain, and support Helm charts and Kustomize overlays as the standard configuration management approach for Kubernetes workloads, providing golden\-path templates that reduce boilerplate for product teams.
* Design, review, and evolve Terraform and Terragrunt modules for infrastructure\-as\-code, including maintaining a public/internal module registry that product and platform teams can consume in a self\-service manner.

**Observability \& reliability**


* Improve and help unify the observability stack; Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager. Fixing
  

metric accuracy issues, building meaningful dashboards, and defining SLOs/alerting that reflect real platform and pipeline health.
* Work across Datadog and VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics to reduce tool sprawl, and help define a
  

coherent strategy for where metrics, logs, and events should live.
* Provide platform\-level telemetry (runner utilization, build queue times, artifact scan results, deployment health) that gives engineering teams and leadership a single, trustworthy view of pipeline and platform performance.

**Internal developer platform, policy \& modern workloads**


* Evaluate and help operate Crossplane as a control\-plane layer for self\-service, Kubernetes\-native infrastructure provisioning, complementing the existing Terraform/Terragrunt IaC estate.
* Contribute to a developer portal / internal catalogue strategy (e.g. Backstage, Cortex, or Port) so engineers have a single place to discover services, ownership, docs, and golden\-path templates.
* Implement and maintain policy\-as\-code guardrails using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA) across the Kubernetes and CI/CD estate (e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines).
* Support Knative\-based serverless/event\-driven workloads on Kubernetes where teams need
  

scale\-to\-zero or request\-driven compute.
* Roll out OpenTelemetry instrumentation and pipelines to standardise traces, metrics, and logs across services, feeding the Grafana/Prometheus/Datadog/VictoriaLogs stack with consistent, correlated telemetry.

**Developer experience \& enablement**


* Act as the platform’s embedded point of contact for one or more product engineering teams:
  

Understand their day\-to\-day friction, prioritise platform work accordingly, and close the loop on
  

delivery.
* Build self\-service tooling, templates, and documentation (golden paths) so engineers can provision runners, publish artifacts, and deploy without needing deep platform expertise.
* Clearly document ownership boundaries between platform and product teams (e.g. base images vs. application extensions) and help engineering teams operate confidently within them.
* Contribute to the platform roadmap, bringing a developer\-experience lens to prioritisation — and measure success in terms of engineer\-facing outcomes such as build time, queue time, and self\-service adoption, not just infrastructure uptime.

**We need you to have**


**Experience \& technical skills**


* 5\+ years in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role, ideally
  

supporting product engineering teams directly.
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runner architectures (Actions Runner Controller / Kubernetes\-based Linux runners, self\-hosted macOS runners) and provisioning them via Terraform.
* Practical knowledge of the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, and ideally Curation) for artifact
  

management and dependency security.
* Familiarity with container registries beyond a single vendor (GHCR/GitHub Packages) and Helm chart repositories such as ChartMuseum on object storage (S3\).
* Experience with GitOps continuous delivery using ArgoCD, and ideally Argo Rollouts for progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) across multiple clusters/environments.
* Strong Kubernetes configuration management skills with Helm and Kustomize.
* Solid Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with Terraform and Terragrunt, including designing and
  

consuming shared/reusable modules.
* Experience with Crossplane (or a comparable Kubernetes\-native control\-plane approach) for building self\-service infrastructure APIs, alongside deep Terraform proficiency for the underlying IaC.
* Experience building or operating an internal developer portal/software catalogue such as Backstage, Cortex, or Port, including modelling service ownership and scorecards.
* Hands\-on experience with policy\-as\-code enforcement in Kubernetes using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA / Gatekeeper) — e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines.
* Familiarity with Knative or similar Kubernetes\-native serverless/eventing frameworks for scale\-to\-zero or request\-driven workloads.
* Experience building, hardening, and optimizing container images (Dockerfile best practices,
  

minimal/hardened base images such as Docker Hardened Images or Chainguard).
* Working knowledge of an observability stack — Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager — plus exposure to Datadog and/or VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics, and practical experience instrumenting services and pipelines with OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics, logs).
* Comfortable in Linux/Unix environments, with solid scripting ability (e.g. Bash, Python, or Go) and strong Git fundamentals.
* AWS cloud experience (compute, storage/S3, networking fundamentals) is a plus.

**Soft skills**


* Genuine product mindset toward internal platforms: you think in terms of the engineer as a customer, and you seek out and act on their feedback.
* Strong cross\-functional collaborator, comfortable embedding with a product engineering team and building trust with people who don’t share your infrastructure background.
* Clear written and verbal communicator, able to explain infrastructure concepts (e.g. Kubernetes, runner sizing, build performance) to engineers without a platform background, and able to tailor the level of detail to the audience.
* Pragmatic and cost\-conscious: able to balance reliability, security, developer speed, and infrastructure cost, and to make and explain trade\-offs rather than defaulting to “more resources.”
* Ownership mindset with strong personal accountability; comfortable working autonomously and
  

driving initiatives from discovery through to rollout.
* Curious and continuously improving: proactively investigates root causes (e.g. inconsistent metrics, flaky runners) rather than just resolving symptoms.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities, and able to sequence and negotiate scope in a fast\-moving, PI\-based planning environment.
* Empathetic and collaborative when defining ownership boundaries between platform and product teams, favouring clarity and shared documentation over friction.

**Would be great if you have**


* Experience supporting mobile/device\-testing CI (e.g. Android emulator/KVM requirements, iOS
  

simulators) in a self\-hosted runner context.
* Experience with developing platform API and CLI for developers to consume blueprints and patterns using either Kratix or Crossplane tooling.
* Experience with large Kubernetes cluster fleet automation from provisioning to upgrade to
  

decommission Experience operating in a large monorepo, including build\-graph/dependency\-aware CI triggering.
* Prior experience defining or operating SLOs/SLAs and error budgets for internal platform services.

**Our offer**


In addition to a great company and challenging projects, we can offer much, much more:


* Agile and friendly atmosphere, non\-violent communication and full respect for diversity
* Possibility to choose remote work or on\-site (in Ł ódź, Poland)
* B2B or Employment Contract – you choose
* Remuneration on B2B contract: 1\.200–1\.400 PLN net/day
* Remuneration on Employment Agreement: 19\.000–22\.000 PLN gross per month

jobs.title: C++ Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:**

Krakow, Lesser Poland, Poland
**Job ID:**

R0145080
**Date Posted:**

2026\-09\-28
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY SERVICES SP. Z O.O.
**Profession (Job Category):**

Engineering \& Science
**Job Schedule:**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced R\&D Software Architect focused on C\+\+ application development for performance‑critical systems to join our technology organization.  



In this role, you will lead the architecture of scalable, high\-performance, and secure software systems built with modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\), with a strong focus on real\-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.  



As an R\&D Architect within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.


You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting\-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real\-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long\-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.  



We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.  



  

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Lead system design in areas like multithreading, synchronization, I/O, and latency requirements for real\-time operation.
* Architect interop layers connecting high\-performance C\+\+ cores to managed runtime services (.NET, RUST) with minimal latency overhead.
* Drive performance optimization and scalability: profile threading behavior, minimizing lock contention, reduce memory allocations in critical paths, and ensure predictable latency at scale.
* Propagate modern programming practices and techniques based on the latest C\+\+ standard.
* Maintain high code quality through code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to SOLID, KISS, DRY and industry best practices.
* Mentor development teams on system design, best practices and maintaining code quality in performance\-critical sections.
* Lead technical architecture reviews, design documentation, and roadmaps for feature development, refactoring initiatives, and legacy code modernization.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transform requirements into clear architectural designs.
* Support strategic technology decisions on dependencies, build tooling, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices.
* Maintain cross\-platform support: drive modernization of build systems, ensure consistency across multiple deployment environments, and support Linux/Windows compatibility.
* Drive Linux development and deployment strategies: architect solutions for Linux environments.
* Contribute to achieving business goals by designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality software solutions.
* Continuously enhance existing systems and contribute to the creation of new features.
* Work effectively within an agile environment, continually expanding your technical expertise and understanding of the business domain.
Actively participate in a cross\-disciplinary team and contribute to shared objectives.  
* 

**Your Background:**

* University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of experience in senior technical or architecture roles.
* Advanced proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) with deep understanding of RAII, smart pointers, STL, concurrency, and memory management.
* Proven experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real\-time system design.
* Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross\-platform development for Windows and Linux.
* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture patterns; demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low\-latency system; good understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
* Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
* Experience with Cloud, DevOps, deep cybersecurity expertise, UI/web development.
* Knowledge of non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
* Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring having familiarity with WAMS/WAMPAC, PMU data, and protection and control applications; understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards; experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU).
* Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC 61850, IEC\-60870\-5\-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37\.118\).
* Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients and exposure to system integration, simulators, or lab environments
* Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
* Solid understanding of numerical methods, signal processing, and control fundamentals and ability to work with high‑frequency, time‑aligned time‑series data
* Good understanding of power system dynamics and the stability challenges introduced by high penetration of renewables
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges; effective team player with good communication skills and willingness to learn.
Excellent command of English (written and spoken).  
* 

  

**More about us**
-----------------

  

We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.


We can provide more information during the recruitment process.  



  

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:


* Private medical care and life insurance
* Access to fitness and wellness programs
* Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
* Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
* Company events and team‑building activities
* Psychological support program
Free parking available  
* 

  

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.


**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java) – Cloud Communications (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
#### **In this role you will:**

**Design \& build**  

 • Design and implement backend services and APIs in modern Java (21\+), Spring Boot and related frameworks  

 • Build distributed, cloud\-native applications using microservice architectures  

 • Work with container technologies (Docker) and Kubernetes, and collaborate with Platform Engineering on infrastructure\-related changes  

 • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation  

  

**Ship \& operate**  

 • Own services end to end following a “you build it, you run it” mindset — including monitoring, logging, troubleshooting and incident response  

 • Use observability tooling (metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, APM) to keep services healthy in production  

 • Apply secure software development practices, including OWASP Top 10, dependency and secrets management  

  

**Collaborate \& improve**  

 • Work in Agile product teams (Scrum/Kanban) with a collaborative, ownership\-driven mindset  

 • Review code, mentor colleagues, and help raise engineering quality across the team  

 • Use AI\-assisted engineering tools where useful to speed up delivery without compromising quality or security  

  

**Important to know**  

 • You will own services end to end. From design through to running them in production  

 • Cloud\-native and DevOps skills (Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability) matter as much as core Java expertise  

 • You will work closely with Platform Engineering, Security and Product — this is a collaborative, not a siloed, role  

 • Our domain is telecommunications and cloud communications, so telecom background is a strong plus but not a requirement  

 • We use AI\-assisted engineering tools as part of our normal workflow and expect openness to them

#### **We’re looking for a person who has:**


 • 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering with a strong focus on Java\-based backend systems  

 • Strong knowledge of modern Java (21\+), Spring Boot, Spring Framework, JPA/Hibernate and RESTful API design  

 • Experience designing and implementing distributed, cloud\-native applications using microservices  

 • Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one modern CI/CD tool (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD)  

 • Fast learning curve with a track record of adapting to changing tech stacks  

 •
   

• Solid grounding in software quality practices: automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD  

 • Good understanding of secure development practices (OWASP Top 10, dependency \& secrets management)  

 • Experience with observability tooling: metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, APM  

 • Comfortable operating production services and responding to incidents  

 • Strong analytical thinking and sound technical decision\-making in complex distributed systems  

 • Fluent in English (written and spoken); German is a plus

#### **Some nice\-to\-have skills:**


Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) or genuine openness to adopting them  

 • Experience with CPaaS or cloud communications platforms, telecom protocols (SIP, RTP, WebRTC), or related open\-source frameworks (FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, Asterisk)  

 • Familiarity with carrier\-grade, highly available, low\-latency distributed systems  

 • Experience with asynchronous messaging / event\-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

#### **Why Apifonica?**

**What we offer**  

 • Compensation: 21,000–25,000 PLN net \+ VAT/month (B2B), depending on experience  

 • Hybrid working model based in the very center of Warsaw  

 • Private health insurance package and sports card coverage (details will be provided during the recruitment process)  

 • An international B2B technology environment: working with clients from various European markets within a rapidly growing technology company  

 • Focus on artificial intelligence and technology: day\-to\-day work with cutting\-edge AI solutions and digital tools  

 • An influential team: an international, highly productive team with a fast decision\-making process and a tangible impact on the company’s growth  

  

**Apifonica** is a communications automation platform that has been operating in the market for over ten years. AI agents, messaging, voice services and numbers operate on our own telecoms infrastructure, managed by **Tenios** – a company within our group and a licensed German operator that has been operating in the telecoms sector since 2001\. A single contract and a single SLA cover all channels, and a single team is responsible for both the AI logic and call quality.  

  

Every month, we handle over 250 million calls and 70 million messages for more than 1,800 business clients, including MAN, ERGO, Toyota, Generali and Leroy Merlin. Our teams are based in Germany, Poland and Latvia; our head office is in Tallinn; and our infrastructure remains in Europe – it is located in Frankfurt, is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and complies with GDPR requirements.

#### **About us**

**Apifonica** is an Estonian company with its headquarters in Tallinn and offices in Poland, Germany (Tenios brand), Italy, Latvia.  

  

We develop cloud\-based voice and messaging communication solutions that help businesses automate communication with their customers. From simple automated notifications to AI\-powered voice bots that integrate with company IT systems and support sales, customer service and HR processes.  

  

Our added value lies in turning complex communication into simple, efficient and business\-driven solutions, tailored to each client’s needs and goals.


More about Apifonica: www.apifonica.com  

More about Tenios: https://www.tenios.de/

jobs.title: Software Engineer - C#
jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to work in a scaled agile environment within international teams developing high\-tech solutions for the medical hearing health care sector. You will be responsible for the development of tools for building, testing, and releasing firmware for our products.

  

More about the role


In this role, you will be part of our R\&D team, and you will be responsible for building an application used by audiologists to adjust the software installed on our new line of hearing aids.


Tasks \& Responsibilities


* Design, develop, test, and maintain software components and features for Sonova's .NET desktop applications and fitting software platform.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers and verification engineers to refine requirements and transform them into effective software solutions.
* Develop intuitive user interfaces using C\#, .NET, WPF, and XAML, including prototyping new concepts and workflows.
* Ensure high software quality through clean code practices, code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to architectural guidelines.
* Perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to maintaining a reliable and sustainable software platform.
* Share knowledge, support onboarding activities, and contribute to engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

More about you


**Essential qualifications:**


* University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 5\+ years of professional software development in C\# with experience .NET, XAML\-based, MVVM capable UI frameworks like Avalonia, Maui, WPF
* Solid understanding of object\-oriented analysis and design, software architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.
* Track record of owning features from idea through release and maintenance.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for delivering high\-quality software.
* Fluent English and confidence communicating in international, distributed teams.

**Good to have qualifications:**


* Experience in regulated environments, ideally medical devices software.
* An interest in audiology or healthcare technology.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, ideally in Azure DevOps.

We understand that you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe this role aligns with your skills and aspirations, we encourage you to apply \- even if you don’t fulfill 100% of the qualifications

  

What we offer


As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. jobs.description:

Lodz \- Lodz, Poland

### **Description \& Requirements**


**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success.


* Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy
* Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision\-making, change management, leadership, and business development
* Obtain 360\-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early\-stage to seasoned leader
  

  

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


We are seeking an experienced Windows IT Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and integration of our Windows\-based infrastructure. You will drive architectural decisions regarding identity management (Active Directory/Entra ID), server operating systems, virtualization, automation, and security compliance. This role bridges high\-level business strategy with hands\-on technical implementation, ensuring that our Microsoft environment is scalable, resilient, and secure.

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**


**Architecture \& Design**


* Design end\-to\-end Windows server and client infrastructure (on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud).
* Develop and maintain the roadmap for Active Directory (AD DS), Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Certificate Services (PKI).
* Architect hybrid identity solutions integrating on\-prem AD with Azure AD (Entra ID) and Microsoft 365\.
* Design virtualization strategies (Hyper\-V, VMware) and storage configurations for Windows workloads.
* Plan high\-availability, disaster recovery, and backup solutions for Windows systems.
  

**Implementation \& Standards**


* Establish standards for Windows Server (2019/2022/2025\) and Windows 10/11 deployment (imaging, Autopilot, MDM).
* Design automated provisioning workflows using PowerShell, DSC (Desired State Configuration), or Ansible.
* Lead migration projects (e.g., legacy to modern platforms, on\-prem to Azure IaaS/PaaS).
* Define monitoring, patching, and update strategies (Windows Update for Business, WSUS, Azure Update Manager).
* Perform proof of concepts (POC) and proof of architecture (POA) with various hardware and software vendors to pick\-up the best solution.

**Security \& Compliance**


* Embed security best practices (Zero Trust, least privilege, LAPS, Credential Guard).
* Design RBAC models, tiered administration, and privileged access workstations (PAWs).
* Ensure compliance with industry standards (SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST) through audit\-ready Windows configurations.
* Collaborate with security teams on endpoint detection, logging (Sentinel/SIEM), and vulnerability management.

**Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Partner with network, storage, and security architects to ensure interoperability.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and architecture diagrams.
* Mentor system administrators and lead technical review sessions.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and provide build vs. buy recommendations.
  

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* **8\+ years** in systems engineering/administration focused on Microsoft technologies.
* Deep expertise in **Active Directory design** (multiple domains/forests, sites, replication, schema management).
* Strong knowledge of **Windows Server core components** (Failover Clustering, File Server, Storage Spaces Direct).
* Experience designing **hybrid identities** (Entra ID Connect, federation, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access).
* Proficiency with **PowerShell scripting** for automation and configuration management.
* Hands\-on experience with **virtualization** (Hyper\-V, VMware vSphere) and SAN/NAS storage integration.
* Solid understanding of **networking** (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, firewalls) as it relates to Windows environments.
  

**Bonus Points if You Have**


* Certifications: **MCSE (Core Infrastructure)** , **Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate**, **Azure Solutions Architect Expert**, or **Identity and Access Administrator Associate**.
* Experience with **Azure IaaS** (VMs, Scale Sets, Managed Disks, Azure Files) and **Azure ARC**.
* Familiarity with **Infrastructure as Code** (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
* Knowledge of **Citrix** or **AVD** (Azure Virtual Desktop) architecture.
* Exposure to **Linux** systems (basic administration or interoperability).
* Analytical problem\-solver with systematic thinking.
* Excellent documentation and diagramming abilities (Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io).
* Strong communication skills – able to explain complex infrastructure to non\-technical leaders.
* Ability to lead crisis troubleshooting efforts and root cause analysis.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment under high stress with consistency and accuracy.
  

**Things To Know**


* This role is based in Łódź, Poland and follows a hybrid work model, **requiring 3 days per week in our Łódź office.**
  

**What You Can Expect**


* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well\-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development
  
  

**Pay Transparency**
zł 210,000 \- zł 330,000
The above represents the annual gross base salary range for this role.  

  

**Variable compensation and allowances:** Dependent on the position offered, other forms of compensation may also be available, such as quarterly or annual bonus pay, commission payments, long term incentive compensation, or certain allowances. Further details will be made available as part of the recruitment process.  

  

**How we set pay:** The pay posted is a reasonable estimate of the wage range anticipated for this position. Pay is determined using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, skills, role scope/responsibilities, and location\-based market factors (where applicable). In appropriate circumstances, based on objective, job\-related factors, the final determination on pay may deviate from the posted range.  

  

**Pay history:** Please do not include current or past pay information in your application. We do not request pay history as part of our recruitment process.  

  

**Benefits:** HARMAN is interested in supporting the health and wellbeing of employees and offers a range of benefits. Offerings vary by country and employment arrangement and reflect a combination of statutory requirements and company\-provided programs. These may include paid time off and holidays, sick and family leave, as well as health and wellbeing support and retirement or savings plans where applicable, along with other locally relevant benefits. Further details will be made available as part of the recruitment process.  

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.  

  

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.  

  

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.

We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.  

  

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job\-related performance.(www.harman.com)

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description** **Hej Software Engineer!**

**Do you want to furnish the future to make room for everyone?**  

  

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.  

  

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our Digital Product Area: “Product Engineering”, a part of Digital Engineering at Inter IKEA, Range. The Product Engineering Area is dedicated to ensuring an attractive, consistent, and efficient way of working for product development and our suppliers. Our goal is to establish a strong foundation for IKEA's product information, enabling its seamless use across the entire value chain. We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden, but you need to have great communication and collaboration skills to be able to integrate our offshore team.

  



**Your new job**  

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who wants to solve complex, real\-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on developing solutions for the handling of materials in our product designers work and you’ll report to a Software Engineering Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:

* Build and evolve our material management solution, a core part of IKEA's digital landscape.
* Develop web applications, APIs, and cloud services using Next.js, .NET, and Azure.
* Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and design to delivery and continuous improvement.
* Be part of a team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and openness, while actively sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* Bring curiosity and contribute ideas that improve both our products and ways of working.
* Ensure high\-quality software through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**  

  

This role as a Software Engineer requires you to:

* Be highly skilled and experienced within React, NextJs and Typescript, a minimum of 3\-5 years of work life experience
* Be highly skilled and experienced within C\# and .NET framework, a minimum of 3\-5 years of work life experience
* Have good knowledge of Azure.
* Have good interpersonal skills: active listening, coaching and facilitation.
* Be an excellent communicator by communicating in a clear, structured and honest way – both with inhouse and offshore team and colleagues
* Have a deep understanding of IKEA's core values and cultural principles as well as a mindset and way of working that reflects this


It’s a plus if you also:

* Worked with CI/CD, Terraform (IaC), Github Actions and cloud services
* Have knowledge of database technologies like MongoDB, Postgres DB
* Have experience with Jest/Playwright for Frontend testing
* Are skilled in building dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a Software Engineer and more!**  

  

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.  

  

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co\-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down\-to\-earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.  



**We welcome your application**  

  

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 13th of October at the latest.  

  

This is a permanent role based in Malmö; hence, you need to be based in Sweden and be able to work from the office. We believe that your presence with the team and working most of the time in the workplace are important.  

  

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Vera Bendz, Recruiter, at vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com. If you have questions about the role, please contact Marie Önnemyr, Hiring Manager, at marie.onnemyr@inter.ikea.com.  

  

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, or what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs.  

  

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

*We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co\-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co\-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.*

jobs.title: Photonics Support Engineer
jobs.description:
***OM JOBBET***  

Som Photonics Support Engineer kommer du att arbeta i ett litet team med erfarna ingenjörer som ansvarar för teknisk support till våra kunder med både rekommendationer före beställning och hjälp med befintlig utrustning. Du kommer ha stort eget ansvar att driva ditt eget arbete framåt, men i mycket tätt samarbete och stöd av övriga medlemmar i gruppen. Du kommer även att samarbeta med ingenjörer från andra delar av koncernen med stor kunskap och erfarenhet inom de specialområden våra kunder jobbar med, som exempelvis optisk mätteknink, optik, lasrar och ljuskällor, optiska fibrer och spektroskopi. Det finns också möjligheter till resor till våra andra kontor för utbildningar och utbyten.


Här i Mölndal utvecklas och tillverkas optiska system, som exempelvis objektiv och avancerade fiberkollimatorer samt instrument för spektroskopi. Genom nära samarbete med våra egna utvecklingsingenjörer kommer du få möjlighet att bygga specialistkunskap inom dessa produktkategorier. För att utveckla produktförståelsen finns dessutom tid till praktiskt arbete i vårt eget lab. I rollen ingår även att representera Thorlabs på mässor inom fotonikområdet, och till viss del kundbesök.

 ***OM DIG***


För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har en högskoleutbildning inom fysik eller motsvarande, gärna med inriktning mot eller examensarbete inom fotonik/optik. Har du praktisk erfarenhet av fotonik/optik\-lab, av optiska simuleringar i Zemax och arbete med kundkontakt är det ett stort plus. Det är även meriterande med kunskaper inom elektronik och programmering i tex Python, C\# eller LabView.


Vi söker dig som är kommunikativ och har lätt för att ge förklaringar på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Du är intresserad av att lära dig nya saker och tycker det är kul att hitta lösningar på frågor som du från start inte har svaret på. Då kundkontakt är en central del av tjänsten är det viktigt att du har en stor vilja att förstå kundernas utmaningar och ett engagemang i att hitta bästa lösningen för dem.


För att trivas hos oss ser vi att du gillar att självständigt finna lösningar och ta egna initiativ, men även aktivt samarbeta med kollegor för att tillsammans nå ett bra resultat. Du trivs med att jobba med internationella kontakter, och har mycket goda kunskaper i engelska och svenska, både i tal och skrift.


***OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN***


Hos oss på Thorlabs får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett engagerat och sammansvetsat team i en internationell miljö där varje dag bjuder på nya utmaningar och möjligheter. Vi är stolta över att erbjuda en trygg och långsiktig anställning med tekniskt spännande produkter och stor möjlighet till personlig utveckling och stort eget ansvar. Utvecklingsmöjligheter finns både i vår lokala och europeiska organisation. Arbetet sker huvudsakligen på plats i våra lokaler, där vi samarbetar och stöttar varandra för att nå våra gemensamma mål.


Våra ljusa och moderna lokaler i Mölndal skapar en trivsam arbetsmiljö där vi värnar om både prestation och välmående. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider som gör det lättare att balansera arbete och fritid, tjänstepension för din trygghet på lång sikt, friskvårdsbidrag som uppmuntrar till god hälsa samt sjukvårdsförsäkring som ger dig extra trygghet om du skulle behöva det. Vi är även anslutna till kollektivavtal, vilket innebär att du får bra villkor och rättvisa förmåner.


***OM FÖRETAGET***

*Thorlabs Sweden AB är en del av en global koncern med över 3 000 anställda världen över. Med en produktportfölj som omfattar mer än 20 000 artiklar är vi en ledande leverantör av fotonikprodukter för forskning och utveckling inom akademi, industri och sjukvård.*

*Koncernen bedriver både försäljning, utveckling och tillverkning på flera platser i USA, Europa och Asien. Vår verksamhet i Sverige etablerades 2004 och har idag 90 medarbetare i moderna lokaler i Mölndal, strax utanför Göteborg.*

*Med avancerade testmiljöer och ett modernt renrum är Thorlabs Sweden särskilt väl rustat för utveckling och tillverkning av högteknologiska optiska system. Vi ansvarar även för teknisk support av samtliga produkter i Thorlabs katalog samt för försäljningsverksamheten i Skandinavien, Baltikum och Polen.*  

  

**Ansök gärna redan idag! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum.**

jobs.title: Fullstack software engineer
jobs.description:
**About Justera Group**  

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high\-performing technology teams and delivering end\-to\-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose\-driven, well\-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are looking for an experienced Fullstack Software Engineer to join a product team working with business\-critical digital products for a leading company in the automotive industry.


You will join a Scrum team responsible for continuously improving and evolving existing digital solutions. The role covers the full development lifecycle, with work across both frontend and backend. The balance between the two will depend on your experience, strengths, and the needs of the team.


This is a role for someone who is comfortable taking ownership, working independently, and contributing from day one. You will work closely with other Senior Software Engineers, Product, Business Analysis, and Technical leadership to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.


The team works with digital customer experiences, including an online platform and solutions supporting the customer journey around test drives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain production software across frontend and backend.
