* Build and maintain scalable solutions using modern development practices.
* Contribute to testing, documentation, technical diagrams, and other development artefacts.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, business analysts, and technical leadership.
* Take ownership of assigned work and contribute independently to the team's delivery.
* Continuously improve existing products and solutions based on business and customer needs.
* Contribute to technical discussions and help identify practical solutions to development challenges.

**Requirements:**

* Formal education in Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 7–10 years of relevant professional experience in software development.
* Strong experience with C\# and .NET.
* Experience with React Router 7\.
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript.
* Experience with Node.js.
* Experience with serverless architecture and AWS.
* Experience working with GraphQL.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development teams.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership from day one.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**It is a plus if you have experience with:**

* Remix
* GitHub
* Datadog
* Headless CMS
* NoSQL
* Azure AD

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting\-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross\-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work\-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

jobs.title: Senior Back-end/Python Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend / Python Developer to design, build, and evolve scalable backend services and data\-intensive systems supporting our Supply Chain planning solutions.


This is a hands\-on senior engineering role with a strong focus on Python backend development, APIs, databases, system design, and data processing. You will take technical ownership of backend components and contribute to architectural decisions, platform modernization, and the development of reliable and maintainable production systems.


You will work with modern data and AI\-enabled solutions, including data pipelines and services supporting AI/ML workloads. While experience with AI technologies is valuable, the core of this position is strong software engineering and backend development in Python.


The role is suited to an experienced developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, building production\-grade software, and contributing to both hands\-on implementation and long\-term technical direction.

**Backend \& Python Development**
---------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain production\-grade backend services and APIs primarily using Python
* Take technical ownership of backend components throughout their lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement
* Design scalable, maintainable, and well\-structured application architectures
* Develop data\-intensive services for ingestion, processing, transformation, and serving of data
* Work extensively with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server
* Design efficient data\-access patterns
* Apply strong object\-oriented design, software engineering principles, and clean coding practices
* Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks
* Ensure high software quality through automated testing, code reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices
* Work with CI/CD and modern development and deployment practices
* Contribute to .NET\-based environments and integrations where relevant
* While the primary focus is backend development, opportunities to contribute to our Vue 3 frontend also exist

**Data Engineering \& AI\-Enabled Systems**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop backend services and data pipelines supporting AI/ML training, evaluation, and inference workloads
* Support the integration and productionization of AI/ML models, engines and services
* Work with technologies and patterns such as RAG, vector databases, and MCP
* Collaborate with application owners to translate application and data requirements into reliable technical solutions
* Contribute to the design of AI\-ready data architectures while maintaining strong software engineering standards

**Architecture \& System Design**
---------------------------------

* Play an active role in backend architecture and technical design decisions
* Design systems for scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency
* Define and promote engineering patterns, standards, and best practices for Python and backend development
* Evaluate frameworks, libraries, platforms, and technologies based on technical and business requirements
* Make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance delivery needs with long\-term maintainability
* Document architectural decisions, interfaces, and important technical designs

**System Evolution \& Modernization**
-------------------------------------

* Modernize existing and legacy backend implementations
* Refactor complex or brittle components into maintainable, well\-tested solutions
* Improve the reliability, observability, performance, and scalability of existing systems
* Support migrations toward modern service and data architectures
* Identify and address technical debt in a structured and pragmatic way
* Help teams balance short\-term delivery requirements with long\-term technical sustainability

**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**
-----------------------------------------

* Mentor and technically support mid\-level and junior developers
* Perform and contribute to code and architecture reviews
* Support technical planning, estimation, and solution design
* Work closely with product, consultancy, data, AI, and infrastructure teams
* Provide technical expertise in client\-facing consultancy and pre\-sales activities
* Communicate technical concepts, architectural decisions, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least 5 years of professional software development experience with Python, with a substantial focus on backend development
* Master of Science (M.Sc.) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, or another relevant technical field
* Strong knowledge of Python and modern Python software development practices
* Demonstrated experience designing and developing production\-grade backend services and APIs
* Strong understanding of software architecture, object\-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean\-code principles
* Strong experience with SQL and relational databases, preferably including PostgreSQL Microsoft and/or SQL Server
* Experience designing and implementing data\-intensive applications, data processing solutions, or data pipelines
* Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD practices
* Experience troubleshooting and optimizing production systems for performance, reliability, and scalability
* Experience working with modern deployment environments, preferably including containers and cloud\-based infrastructure
* Ability to independently drive technical tasks from requirements and design through implementation and production
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams
* Professional working proficiency in English

**Meriting Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience with Flask, Pandas or other comparable Python backend frameworks
* Experience with asynchronous Python and distributed or event\-driven systems
* Experience with workflow orchestration and data engineering platforms
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms
* Experience with Azure and the Microsoft technology ecosystem
* Experience with .NET/C\#
* Experience with AI/ML production systems and model integration
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM\-based applications, and MCP
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and production operations
* Experience with Vue 3 or other modern frontend technologies
* Experience in Supply Chain, planning, optimization, or related data\-intensive business domains
* Previous experience mentoring developers or acting as a technical lead

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================


You are an experienced Python developer with a strong software engineering foundation and a track record of building reliable backend systems. You are comfortable working across application logic, APIs, databases, data processing, and system architecture, and you understand what it takes to operate software successfully in production.


You enjoy hands\-on development but can also step back and consider the broader architecture. You can make pragmatic technical decisions, explain trade\-offs, improve existing systems, and help other developers grow.


Experience with data engineering and AI\-enabled applications is highly valuable, but deep Python and backend engineering expertise is the foundation of this role.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds readiness and resilience software for defence, public safety and critical infrastructure organisations in more than 70 countries. Our Exonaut platform is used to plan, run and evaluate large\-scale training, exercises and capability evaluations, and our consultants and engineers work alongside those organisations across Europe, North America and beyond.

**What we're building**


We're building the evidence layer for defence experimentation and evaluation. When an organisation tests a new capability — a sensor, an autonomous system, a different way of operating — it has to be able to defend the result afterwards, to someone who was not there and who has every reason to challenge it. Today that evidence lives in spreadsheets, documents and standalone survey tools, and it cannot be traced from a conclusion back to the observation that supports it.


Our platform fixes the structure before the data is collected, captures evidence from people and from machines, fuses it into chains that carry their own provenance, and keeps every finding traceable to its source. The hard part is not the plumbing. It is holding one coherent model steady while every customer arrives with their own vocabulary, their own method and a reasonable\-sounding request for one more special case.

**How we build**


Modern Java — currently 25 — and Spring Boot on a modular JPMS architecture, an Angular 21 single\-page application, PostgreSQL with PostGIS, deployed to Kubernetes.


The principles are conservative on purpose. Dependency inversion at every module boundary: contracts in an API module, implementation separate, no reverse dependencies. Schema evolution is explicit and reversible, through migrations with rollback scripts and no auto\-DDL in any environment. Evolutionary change over rewrites, with a staged path when a domain concern outgrows its boundary. Structural decisions are argued in RFCs and recorded in ADRs, and changes to the core domain model go through that process rather than around it — because that model is the product, and it is the thing most easily damaged under delivery pressure.


Three constraints shape most of what we do. It runs inside the customer's own environment: single\-tenant, sovereign, accredited, sometimes with no route to the internet at all, so nothing may assume a managed cloud service. Evidence has to be captured where the work happens, which means a tablet in a field with no connectivity and a sync that loses nothing. And the audit trail is immutable — evidence cannot be quietly deleted or backdated, and no automated process publishes a conclusion without a person taking responsibility for it.

**You**


We are a small team, so you will work across the stack rather than behind a specialism. Substantial experience in either Java or TypeScript, and a genuine willingness to be useful in the other. Sound judgement about data modelling, because most of the interesting problems here are modelling problems wearing engineering clothes. Comfortable with ambiguity: requirements move, and the shape of the answer is often the work.


A real advantage, though none of it is required: sovereign, air\-gapped or accredited deployments; offline\-first or sync\-heavy applications; geospatial data; sensor, telemetry or simulation integration; audit and traceability requirements. The domain is learnable, the judgement less so.


The team is small enough that your work is visible and your arguments carry. Your designs will be challenged and you will be expected to challenge back — including on scope.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Capability decisions get made on this evidence. When an organisation concludes that something is ready, or that it is not, that judgement has consequences for the people who depend on it. Making it defensible is the whole point.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript,


Python or Go).

* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why join 4C Strategies**


This is a small team with a large surface. You will not be handed a narrow lane: the platform is still being shaped, the domain model is still being argued about, and the person who makes the argument well is the person who decides. If you would rather own a hard, open problem end to end than take tickets from a backlog, that is the job.


The work matters: what you build helps defence, public safety and resilience organisations prepare for the situations they hope not to face.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer**

**Reports to: Engineering Manager**

**Department: Engineering**

**Location: Gothenburg, Remote in Sweden**


Avinode is looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team on a permanent basis. Over the past year we’ve been on a modernisation streak, reducing our maintenance load to be able to grow the team’s responsibilities and the kind of projects we can sustainably undertake. We’ve recently fully rebuilt our PCI enviornment, and are now undertaking a project to finalise our transition to exclusively running containerised services.


The team you’ll join consists of 4 DevOps/Site Reliability/Platform Engineers, supported by an Engineering Manager with a background in Site Reliability Engineering. We operate a cloud\-only environment and are responsible for its operation, availability, observability and security. Most of our systems are Linux\-based and run Java applications. But for this position we’re looking for someone with experience supporting a .NET/C\# and Windows application stack, or being an experienced .NET/C\# developer with an affinity for platform engineering and cloud infrastructure.

**What you’ll do**


You’ll support the team as we work through adopting, modernising and rebuilding this part of our cloud environment. This will involve:

* Ensuring the Windows environment remains in good shape, through practices like automated security patching, configuration management and good integration with our observability stack.
* Improving and simplifing our Continuous Integration systems and pipelines.
* Contributing to the applications to improve how they leverage current Azure services, or adopt new Azure services, to reduce the maintenance cost.
* Harmonising how we operate and maintain our Windows and Linux environments, adopting the same toolset and practices across both where feasible.
* Supporting the work to run these applications on a Linux\-backed containerised stack.
* Contributing to the team’s roadmap, which will involve work related to security, observability and improving the developer experience.

**Who you are**

* You are a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer with 3\+ years of experience supporting a .NET/C\# and Windows stack for SaaS services. Or,
* You are a .NET/C\# developer with 3\+ years of experience, with an affinity for cloud infrastructure and at least a year of experience running and operating Windows systems to host SaaS services.
* You have worked with infrastructure in cloud environments before. We use Azure, but experience with AWS or GCP is welcome too.
* You’re familiar with tools like terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure Machine Configuration (or equivalent) etc.
* You have some familiarity with Linux systems and running containers.
* You have an interest in the security of our systems and infrastructure.
* You have a product mindset, seeing the infrastructure and our tooling as services we offer to other teams.
* You are self\-driven and can figure things out on your own with some support from others.

**What do we offer you?**


We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.

* Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations.
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important.
* Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.

**Want to join our crew?**


Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.title: Integration Platform Engineer (.NET/API)
jobs.description:
**Om rollen**


Hemsö är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag med ett växande bestånd i Sverige, Finland och Tyskland. Vi befinner oss mitt i en ambitiös digitaliseringsresa — Digitala Klivet 2030 — där smart förvaltning, datadrivna beslut och sömlösa systemkopplingar är avgörande för att nå våra mål


Som Integration Platform Lead äger du den tekniska infrastruktur som binder samman Hemsös system. Du ansvarar för API\-plattformen och de integrationer som möjliggör allt från felanmälan till dataflöden mot vår analysplattform. Det är en roll med tydligt systemägarskap, bred teknisk räckvidd och direktpåverkan på hur Hemsö fungerar i vardagen.


Vad du kommer att göra:

**API\-plattform och integrationer**


Du är systemansvarig för Hemsös integrations\- och API\-plattform och de integrationer som kopplar samman verksamhetens system — fastighetssystem, felanmälan, HR, ekonomi och dataflöden mot analysplattformen ThoughtSpot. Du designar, bygger och förvaltar dessa kopplingar i .NET och Azure, inklusive automatiserade jobb som synkar data och triggar flöden mellan system. Du ansvarar även för den underliggande infrastrukturen, som definieras med Terraform och hanteras genom Azure DevOps\-pipelines. Du håller ett löpande fokus på stabilitet, teknisk skuld och beroenden.

**Felanmälan och Topdesk\-ekosystemet**


Du har förvaltnings\- och utvecklingsansvar för felanmälansflödet samt Hemsös hyresgästportal och de integrationer som omger Topdesk. Det innebär att du säkerställer att kopplingarna mot kringliggande system fungerar korrekt, att processlogiken hålls intakt vid förändringar, och att du kommunicerar proaktivt med berörda parter när något behöver justeras. Du samarbetar nära med den projektledare som äger felanmälansprocessen.

**Driftstabilitet och systemförvaltning**


Du hanterar uppdateringar, säkerhetspatchar och livscykelförändringar i en miljö med många externa beroenden. När en partner ändrar sitt API, en driftmiljö förändras eller ett certifikat löper ut ser du till att det landar utan störningar. Du arbetar proaktivt, dokumenterar tydligt och håller intressenter informerade i god tid. Vid incidenter eller driftstörningar samordnar du felsökning, driver dialogen med berörda parter och säkerställer att åtgärder vidtas för att minska risken för återkommande problem.

**AI som arbetsverktyg och agent\-enabler**


Du använder AI\-stödda verktyg naturligt i ditt dagliga arbete — för att skriva kod snabbare, felsöka smartare och bygga bättre lösningar. Du bidrar också till att Hemsös agentplattform (som ligger på Databricks) får de integrationer och API:er den behöver för att fungera i praktiken. Det är inte din roll att äga agentutvecklingen, men du är en möjlig\-görare för det arbetet. Du kan även vara behjälplig att ta ett egenutvecklat system från Claude Code/Lovable till produktion.

**Vem vi söker**


Du har gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i .NET och känner dig hemma i Azure — App Services, Functions, integrationsflöden och API\-design. Du har arbetat i miljöer med många systemberoenden och vet vad det innebär att äga en plattform på riktigt: inte bara koda, utan förvalta, prioritera och hålla ihop helheten över tid. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Infrastructure as Code och automatiserade driftsättningar.


Du är självgående och trivs i en roll där ansvar och frihet hänger ihop. Du kommunicerar lika naturligt med en kollega i förvaltningen som undrar varför felanmälan inte fungerar som med en backend\-arkitekt som vill diskutera integrationsmönster. Du är nyfiken på AI\-verktyg och ser dem som ett sätt att leverera bättre — inte som ett buzzword.


Erfarenhet av HTMX eller liknande server\-side rendering\-mönster är ett plus — rollen arbetar med gränssnitt som Mina sidor och felanmälan, där designkomponenter redan är på plats och en backend\-profil förväntas kunna bidra till frontendutvecklingen. Det samma gäller bakgrund från verksamhetsnära systemarbete där tekniken behöver möta processer och människor, inte bara andra system.

**Vi erbjuder**


Hos Hemsö får du möjlighet att påverka investeringar och projekt som gör verklig skillnad för människor och samhällen. Du blir en del av en organisation med långsiktigt perspektiv, hög kompetens och korta beslutsvägar. Här kombineras professionell utveckling med ett tydligt samhällsuppdrag och en kultur som präglas av ansvar, samarbete och tillit.

**Om Hemsö**


Hemsö är ett av Sveriges ledande fastighetsbolag inom samhällsfastigheter. Vi äger, förvaltar och utvecklar miljöer där människor bor, lär, vårdas och arbetar. Vår verksamhet finns i Sverige, Finland och Tyskland. Vår vision är att stärka samhällets ryggrad genom långsiktigt hållbara investeringar som skapar trygghet, nytta och värde – både för våra hyresgäster och för samhället i stort.


Hos oss arbetar engagerade medarbetare som delar en stark värdegrund präglad av ansvarstagande, samarbete och utveckling. Vi kombinerar professionalism med omtanke och erbjuder en arbetsmiljö där du får möjlighet att växa – både i din roll och som individ.

**Ansökan**


I denna rekrytering samarbetar Hemsö med Alpaca Talent. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Diana Nesic Possman på diana@alpacatalent.com Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan. jobs.title: Professional Electrical Engineer, Projects & Overhauls
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29209
Category: Engineering \- Electrical
Job Type: Full\-time  

The Generation Engineering department in ESB Engineering and Major Projects (EMP) is the centre of engineering for ESB’s generation businesses. The Projects \& Overhauls department function within Generation Engineering is to aide ESB Generation \& Trading (G\&T) in the delivery of overhauls \& outages across the asset portfolio, both thermal \& Hydro focused.


We currently have an opportunity for Senior Electrical Engineers within the Projects \& Overhauls Team in Generation Engineering. The successful candidate will support ESB with the management of overhaul projects on existing assets for ESB G\&T.


Suitable candidates will aide in the technical delivery of electrical plant overhauls across the ESB Generation portfolio, both thermal \& Hydro focused. Aligned with same, candidates should have a background in construction, commissioning, maintenance, or operation of:

  

* Generators


* AVR Systems


* MV/LV Switchgear \& Technologies


* Electrical Control \- Systems \& Protections


* Transformers


* Power Generation Electrical Balance of Plant Technologies.


* Knowledge of Power Generation Control Systems (DCS).


* Other heavy industrial experience as applicable.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to the following:


* Support Overhaul Planning \& Programme: Aide the Station \& Project Manager in the planning phase through to safe \& efficient delivery of electrical plant scopes aligned with Overhaul / Outage programmes.


* Support the Asset Management Process: Support on technical input, liaison with Asset Specialists \& reporting on assets pre/post overhaul to the aide in the Long\-Term Asset Planning.


* Advance experience \& knowledge in Generation assets: In preparation \& delivery of overhauls, develop a thorough understanding of electrical asset types applicable to each station, including electrical balance of plant areas. (Plant area knowledge training for specific asset types will be provided).


* Contract Management \& Procurement: Manage allocated electrical contracts and other assigned work scopes, including procurement elements such as specification generation, tendering, evaluations \& awards.


* Safety Compliance: Ensure all project works comply with statutory safety, health, and environmental regulations and ESB Technical Standards \& Guidelines. Where required, carry out authorized roles under the safety rules (Safe Systems of Work), training for same \& plant area knowledge development will be provided.


* Inspection \& Test Plans: Implement Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs) for electrical assets in collaboration with the relevant internal Competent Persons and/or Asset Management Specialists.


* Supervision \& Quality Assurance: Supervise contractors' work daily, review ITP protocol sheets, and ensure work quality aligns with Project Quality Plan. Quality assurance at the work interface will be a key feature of the role.


* Audits \& Reporting: Conduct regular safety, environment, and quality audits; report progress against schedule; attend project meetings.


* Outage Planning \& Execution: Plan and supervise engineering site works for outages and overhauls on main/ ancillary electrical plant equipment.

  

**Experience and Qualifications**


* Proven track record of significant experience in the power generation industry. A minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience is required.


* The candidate will possess competence in design, construction, commissioning, maintenance or operation of electrical systems in power generation or related process/ heavy industry.


* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to manage stakeholders, to work and share knowledge within a team structure and to make quality decisions and judgements


* The candidate will possess project engineering and project management skills, strong time management and prioritisation skills


* Strong communication, report writing skills and proficient computer skills (including MS Office)


* Well versed with health, safety, construction and environment standards and procedures, including risk assessment skills


* Full clean driving license (B car licence)

  

**Essential**


* Primary Degree in Electrical Engineering (Level 8 NFQ) or equivalent relevant work experience.

  

**Desirable**


* Chartered Engineering status with a recognised engineering institution or demonstrable evidence of progress towards same is preferred.

  

**Location**


ESB Engineering and Major Projects office, The Sidings, Grand Canal Dock, Dublin 2 or EMP Eastgate Cork. Due to the nature of the work most time will be spent on site for the preparation and delivery of overhaul works. Flexibility is important in this role as the role may require include travel both nationally \& internationally.

  

**Reporting to**


Projects \& Overhauls Team Leader – Generation Engineering Delivery

  

* **Why Work with Us?**



	+ Opportunity to lead Ireland’s transition to net zero carbon future
	+ Career development through mentoring and training
	+ Corporate Social Responsibility Opportunities
	+ Sports and Social Clubs
	+ Networking opportunities
	+ Credit Union
	+ Generous Pension
	+ Access to staff well\-being programmes
	+ Generous parental leave entitlements
	+ Strong values\-based and inclusive culture
	+ Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
	+ Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted**Salary**


€59,000 \- €70,000 per annum

  

**Closing Date**


12th October 2026

  

**Interview**


Candidates shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:



	+ Accountable and Ethical
	+ Collaborative
	+ Growing and Adaptive
	+ Proactive
	+ Respectful and SupportiveMore information is available on Our People Promise

  

**Notes**


Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.


The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland prior to commencement of employment.
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.


**About ESB**


Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - IAM
jobs.description:
**What you tell your friends you do**


“I develop the identity and access management that keeps Aize secure and seamless, shaping the product experience as much as the code.”

**What you will really be doing**


Build and evolve responsive React and TypeScript experiences that make complex IAM workflows clear and intuitive.


Make pragmatic design decisions with product managers and our design system team, keeping the application cohesive while balancing functionality and deadlines.


Design and maintain integrations between our portal, backend services, and assorted third\-party systems.


Work across a broad surface area: backend, React frontend, and the DevOps infrastructure that keeps everything running.


Shape features with the product team scoping, estimating, and challenging the “why” behind what we build.


Mentor teammates, contribute to architectural discussions, and help facilitate agile ceremonies.


Support a team that owns everything end\-to\-end, from infra to UI, in a domain where you can grow.

**How you will be doing this**

* Working as part of a self\-driven team of seven that owns an entire “app within the app” \- full flow, full responsibility.
* Using and improving our DevOps setup (Terraform, CI/CD, cloud platforms), building on the foundations already established.
* Mostly focusing on frontend, but with the opportunity to jump into frontend and infrastructure when it makes sense.
* Collaborating closely with other engineering teams and other disciplines to balance technical depth with user and business needs.
* Bring your experience, curiosity, and the right attitude to help the team scale.

**Why you are doing this**


You are building a secure, scalable backbone that enables the product to function reliably as it grows. It protects customer trust and ensures users can access the product seamlessly.

**Who we think you are**

* An engineer who takes ownership, makes sound design and technical decisions, and navigates a broad product landscape.
* Strong in React and TypeScript, with experience building maintainable, accessible, and user\-friendly applications.
* Comfortable contributing to CI/CD and modern development practices; experience owning pipelines or third\-party systems is a plus.
* Curious about IAM or identity\-related domains, even if you haven’t worked in them before; C\#/.NET backend knowledge is a plus.
* Experience with identity solutions or platforms such as Auth0, Frontegg, Keycloak, Identiy Server is a plus.
* Comfortable collaborating with product managers, designers, and engineers, coordinating work, and contributing to architectural discussions.
* Someone who thinks holistically: cohesive product design, purpose, users, functionality, and deadlines \- not just code.

**Team**


We build and maintain the secure, scalable foundations that power the product, including user access and core platform services. Our work is AI\-enabled and follows modern software development lifecycle practices.


We collaborate closely across engineering, product, and security, supported by structured ceremonies, clear roadmap, and shared ownership. We practice continuous delivery using feature toggles to release changes safely and incrementally.

*Grounded*, *human*, and *unstoppable* are the values that guide our day\-to\-day. If that aligns with how you like to work, we’d love to hear from you

**We offer:**

* Money
* Hybrid work and flexible hours
* A MacBook or laptop running Windows, so you can get work done
* Support to help you keep your money: we chip in on your pension, pay for your work travels and keep you safe with insurance
* Care for your wellbeing, including an on\-site private health clinic and covered check\-ups
* Room for you to do things your way and be who you are
* Opportunities to learn and share through our professional Guilds, helping you grow your skills and inspire those around you
* Vacation perks \- maybe a few days at one of our cabins (Gaustablikk, Beitostølen, Hafjell, Tjøme, Spain \+\+). Just remember to come back
* Support for your passions through events, training and courses, you choose what interests you
* And of course the good stuff \- free phone plan, home broadband, solid hardware, on\-site gym, great lunch, afterwork socials and occasional celebration along the way

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:

Monitor application performance and implement improvements to system reliability

jobs.title: Backend- og DevOps-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce-team
jobs.description:
**Erfaren backend\- og DevOps\-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce\-team**  

Vil du arbejde med både backendudvikling, integrationer og den teknik, der får løsningerne sikkert i drift? Vi søger en erfaren backend\- og DevOps\-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce\-team i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Du kommer til at arbejde med de systemer, der ligger bag vores hjemmesider og online booking – fra udvikling og databaser til deployment, fejlsøgning og drift. Vi står foran en større modernisering af vores digitale platform og bookingløsning. Samtidig har vi eksisterende systemer, som skal fungere stabilt, mens vi bygger nyt. Derfor leder vi efter en udvikler, der både kan skrive god kode og interesserer sig for, hvad der sker med løsningen, efter den er deployet.

  

  

**Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?**  

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:


* Udvikle og vedligeholde backend\-løsninger i C\# og .NET
* Bygge og vedligeholde integrationer til hotel\-, booking\- og betalingssystemer
* Arbejde med Microsoft SQL Server og vores databaser
* Automatisere arbejdsgange og driftsopgaver med PowerShell
* Vedligeholde og forbedre vores build\- og deployment\-processer
* Arbejde med overvågning, fejlsøgning og sikker drift
* Være med til at modernisere vores eksisterende løsninger
* Sparre med resten af teamet om arkitektur og tekniske valg


Rollen er en blanding af backendudvikling og DevOps. Du behøver ikke være ekspert i alt, men du skal have solid erfaring og lyst til at arbejde på tværs og tage ansvar for løsningerne hele vejen fra kode til produktion.

  

  

**Vores tekniske setup**  

Vi arbejder blandt andet med:


* C\# og .NET 4\.8 samt .NET 10
* Microsoft SQL Server
* PowerShell
* Windows Server og i mindre omfang Linux
* TeamCity til builds
* Octopus Deploy til deployment
* GitLab
* TypeScript og JavaScript – også i dele af backenden


Vi kommer til at arbejde mere med containerbaseret drift. Derfor er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Kubernetes og Docker eller Podman.

  

  

**Hvem er du?**  

Vi forventer, at du har minimum fem års erfaring fra en lignende stilling og en solid baggrund inden for C\# og .NET.


Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:


* Har erfaring med SQL og databaser
* Har arbejdet med eller har interesse for CI/CD, deployment og drift
* Kan sætte dig ind i eksisterende systemer og kode
* Arbejder struktureret med fejlsøgning og problemløsning
* Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs
* Kan forklare tekniske problemstillinger og har lyst til at dele din viden og sparre med resten af teamet


Erfaring med serverdrift, containere eller integrationer mellem flere systemer er en fordel. Vi forventer dog ikke, at du kan sætte flueben ved samtlige teknologier på listen.

  

  

**Dit team**  

Du bliver en del af IT Digital Commerce, hvor vi arbejder med Arp\-Hansen Hotel Groups hjemmesider, bookingløsninger og andre digitale løsninger til vores gæster og hoteller. Teamet består af udviklere, UX’ere og en team lead. Vi arbejder tæt sammen og har en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne. Der er plads til at stille spørgsmål, udfordre eksisterende løsninger og komme med forslag til, hvordan vi kan gøre tingene bedre. Vi udvikler selv vores centrale løsninger. Det betyder, at du kommer tæt på både systemerne og de mennesker, der bruger dem, og at du får mulighed for at være med til at forme den tekniske retning.

  

  

**Din arbejdsplads**  

Vores kontor ligger i Gentofte, og vi arbejder fra kontoret fire dage om ugen. Der er mulighed for én ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag, men stillingen er ikke en remote\-stilling. Du får en hverdag med både nyudvikling, modernisering og ansvar for løsninger, der allerede er i drift. Nogle opgaver er store og langsigtede, mens andre handler om at finde og løse et konkret problem eller få et hotfix i produktion her og nu. Tonen er uformel, og stemningen er uhøjtidelig. Vi siger tingene, som de er, hjælper hinanden og forsøger at holde mængden af unødigt bureaukrati på et minimum.


Vi opfordrer alle – uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund – til at ansøge om arbejde hos os i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Vi tror på, at et mangfoldigt og inkluderende arbejdsmiljø er fundamentet for at opbygge tillid, skabe nærvær og fremme ambitioner. Det er vores mål at placere os helt i front i branchen med fokus på kvalitet, service og trivsel for gæster og medarbejdere. Hos os bliver alle ansøgere vurderet på deres kvalifikationer og potentiale, og vi prioriterer at skabe et miljø, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte.


Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig! Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.


  
Application due
18\-10\-2026  


Start date
Start hurtigst muligt  


Position category
IT\-afdeling  


Position type
Fuldtid  


Workplace  


Homepage
http://www.arp\-hansen.dk  


**Questions regarding the position**
====================================


**Jacob Nielsen**
  
Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group er en familieejet virksomhed med central beliggenhed i København og Aarhus. Vi har over 5000 værelser, 60\+ mødelokaler og en kongressal. Vores hoteller udgør cirka 20 % af Københavns værelseskapacitet og omfatter Phoenix Copenhagen, 71 Nyhavn Hotel, Copenhagen Strand, Imperial Hotel, The Square, Tivoli Hotel \& Congress Center, Copenhagen Island, Gentofte Hotel, 4 Wakeup Copenhagen hoteller samt to luksushostels, Steel House Copenhagen og Next House Copenhagen.



Vores målsætning er at være blandt de bedste i branchen, når det kommer til kvalitet, service og tilfredshed. På vores kontor i Gentofte er vi omkring 100 kolleger, der dækker forskellige støttefunktioner inden for Sales, Marketing \& Brand, HR, Central Group Sales \& Reservations, Sustainability, Supply Chain, Finance og IT. Vores opgave er at give vores kolleger på hotellerne den bedste support, så vi sammen kan fokusere på at give vores gæster de bedste oplevelser.



Siden vores begyndelse i 60'erne har vi været familieejet, og det er familien Arp\-Hansens værdier, der i dag udgør grundlaget for vores virksomhed. Vi behandler vores medarbejdere ordentligt, vi stræber altid efter udvikling og sammen er vi alle en del af familien. Alle vores hoteller og hostels er Green Key certificerede hvilket, sammen med øvrige bæredygtige initiativer, bekræfter vores høje fokus på bæredygtighed.


**Tillid**, **nærvær** og at være **ambitiøs** – vores tre værdier, som afspejler, hvordan vi arbejder i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Vi tror på, at vi vokser, tager mere ansvar og får større arbejdsglæde, når vi bliver vist **tillid** – og får hjælp, når vi har brug for det. **Nærvær** indebærer at være til stede og udvise ægte interesse for både kolleger og gæster på vores hoteller og hostels. At være **ambitiøs** er en naturlig del af at drive forretning. Det er ganske enkelt mere givende, altid at forsøge at gøre tingene lidt bedre.



Hos Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group ser vi dig som den person, du er. Vi er sikre på, at du vil føle dig hjemme hos os, for når du føler dig hjemme, kan du få vores gæster til at føle det samme. "Lad din karriere komme hjem."

jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Manufacturing Test Software Engineer
**Description \-**

We are looking for a Manufacturing Test Software Engineer to join our team and help develop reliable, scalable, and high\-quality manufacturing test solutions for HP products.


In this role, you will work with product development, factory, quality, and external partners to design, implement, validate, and improve test software used in manufacturing. You will support both new product introduction and sustaining programs, helping to ensure product quality, production readiness, and factory efficiency.


This role is ideal for junior\-to\-mid level engineers who enjoy software development, test automation, problem solving, and working closely with both engineering and manufacturing teams. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, image processing, and advanced automation to improve test coverage, strengthen defect detection, and optimize manufacturing efficiency.


Engineers with strong programming fundamentals and a keen interest in test automation, embedded systems, image processing, or AI/ML applications are also welcome to apply.


Key Responsibilities


* Develop and support manufacturing test solutions with product development and production teams to ensure product quality, performance, and manufacturability.
* Design, implement, and validate test software for new and existing products across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and system\-level requirements.
* Work with internal teams and external partners to support project execution, production readiness, and issue resolution.
* Support the creation, validation, and delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and high\-quality manufacturing test packages.
* Represent the manufacturing test team in project discussions, technical reviews, and issue\-resolution forums.
* Provide training, documentation, and technical support to users within and outside HP.
* Improve test software robustness and support factory and quality teams in troubleshooting production issues.
* Analyze test failures, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to product design, test coverage, and manufacturing quality.
* Optimize test solutions to improve throughput, reduce test cycle time, and enhance factory productivity.

Knowledge and Skills


* Experience or strong interest in software development, test automation, embedded systems, firmware, image processing, AI/ML, and autonomous or agentic solutions.
* Programming knowledge in languages and tools such as Python, SQL, VB, C\#, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with data analysis, software testing methodology, test plan execution, debugging, test scripts, and automation tools.
* Interest or exposure to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and related frameworks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand software, hardware, and system\-level requirements and translate them into practical test solutions.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and adapt to changing requirements.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and local language.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

Scope and Impact


* Supports product quality, manufacturing readiness, delivery timelines, and factory efficiency.
* Works closely with software engineering leaders, architects, technology leads, product development teams, factories, and external partners.
* Contributes to timely technical issue resolution and continuous improvement of manufacturing test effectiveness.

Education and Experience


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience preferred.
* Engineer with strong programming fundamentals and interest in test automation, embedded systems, image processing, or AI/ML applications are welcome to apply.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer 2
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
Position Summary:


The Manufacturing Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and supporting digital manufacturing solutions across MES, equipment data systems, operational applications, analytics platforms, and AI\-enabled manufacturing capabilities.


This role partners with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and OT teams to build and sustain data\-driven manufacturing workflows that improve operational efficiency, equipment reliability, troubleshooting effectiveness, and digital transformation initiatives
  

  

Position Responsibilities:


* Design, develop, and support digital/AI manufacturing solutions that improve operational efficiency, data visibility, and decision\-making across manufacturing operations.
* Design and support system integrations between manufacturing and equipment enterprise systems, equipment data sources and enterprise data platforms.
* Develop and optimize databases, data pipelines, APIs, and reporting solutions to ensure reliable and scalable manufacturing data flows.
* Design and build AI agents capable of making business\-context\-aware decisions, taking actions across enterprise systems and workflows, and operating autonomously within defined guardrails
* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI\-powered products, applications, and intelligent workflow solutions
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, OT, and IT teams to translate business requirements into digital solutions.
* Support system testing, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of manufacturing applications and integrations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through automation, analytics, and digital transformation projects.
Contribute to future manufacturing capabilities including operational intelligence, AI\-assisted troubleshooting, predictive analytics, and smart manufacturing solutions.  
* 

  

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.  



  

Position Requirements:


* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* 3\-5 years of experience in software development, application development, systems engineering, system integration, data engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong database design and development experience using Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization, views, and stored procedures.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or equivalent object\-oriented languages.
* Experience developing and supporting software applications, APIs, and system integrations.
* Experience using source control and version management tools such as GitHub.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, collaborate across functions, and deliver high\-quality solutions in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
* Understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), testing methodologies, and deployment practices.
* Experience with building and deploying AI agents in enterprise environments
* Demonstrated success developing agents that interact with and coordinate activities across multiple business platforms and technology ecosystems.
Experience implementing multi\-agent architectures, agent orchestration frameworks, tool calling and workflow execution, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning systems.  
* 

  

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities  



  

Preferred Experience/Education/Skills:


* Experience with manufacturing systems, or industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Power BI, Databricks, Azure, cloud technologies, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and analytics platforms.
* Experience implementing AI solutions within large, global enterprises
* Exposure to operational technology, equipment connectivity, or industrial automation environments.
* Knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, enterprise knowledge management, and RAG solution patterns.
* Experience developing operational dashboards, reporting solutions, manufacturing applications, or workflow automation tools.
* Knowledge of AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, diagnostic solutions, knowledge management systems
* Experience working in regulated manufacturing, medical device, biotechnology, life sciences, semiconductor, or high\-tech manufacturing environments.
Demonstrated interest in digital transformation, manufacturing systems integration, data\-driven operations, and smart manufacturing initiatives.  
* 

  

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero\-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Designing and developing the web\-based 3D IFC model viewer, from architecture through to implementation
* Exploring and evaluating relevant open\-source libraries and tools (e.g. IFC parsers, WebGL frameworks)
* Implementing model navigation features (e.g. object selection, section cuts, and property inspection, etc.)
* Collaborating with backend engineers on server\-side geometry processing and data APIs
* Optimising viewer performance when dealing with large, complex files
* Iterating on the viewer based on feedback from end users
**Requirements**
----------------


* Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript and backend JS runtimes (e.g. Node.js/Deno)
* Good understanding of 3D graphics and/or computational geometry concepts
* Strong problem solving skills and a desire to learn
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Familiarity with any of the following would be a plus:


* Web development (Frontend/Backend/Full\-stack)
* WebGL or related 3D frameworks (e.g. Babylon.js)
* Python and libraries like IfcOpenShell
* Building Information Modeling (BIM) concepts
* Geospatial data and information
* Agentic development workflows (e.g Claude Code)
* WebAssembly
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**


Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.


As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:


**Diversity and Inclusion** \- we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.


**Digital inclusion** \- at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.


**Environmental Sustainability** \- Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious 'A list' for its commitment to the Net\-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by2020**.**


Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the **World's Most Ethical Companies** for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business. Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.


Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

jobs.title: Senior CI/CD Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SIOUX
  
  

Sioux Group was founded in 1996 in the Netherlands. With over 1,400 engineers, Sioux supports or acts as the R\&D partner of leading high\-tech companies. We aim to add value to our clients by developing innovative and high\-tech solutions that contribute to a smarter, safer, healthier, more enjoyable, and more sustainable society.
  
  

Sioux has been recognized as an employer of choice, including awards such as Best ICT Company to Work For and Great Place to Work. In addition to our strong presence in Europe, Sioux is rapidly expanding in Asia, with offices in Vietnam, China, Singapore, and India.
  
  

With a strong heritage and a diverse international team, Sioux is proud of our core values: Own it and make it happen, Grow and innovate together, and Surprise customers. If these values resonate with you, we would love to welcome you to our team.
  
  

We are looking for a Senior CI/CD Engineer based in Asia to make our builds faster, our pipelines more reliable, and our automated testing part of every change. You will focus on build performance for our C\#/.NET and C\+\+ software and on bringing tests and static analysis into CI. You will work closely with development, verification, our test architect and IT\-DevOps teams in Europe and Asia.
  
  

Today, a full end\-to\-end pipeline runs around 200 jobs and over 10,000 automated tests and takes about 4 hours. Your main goal is to cut that time significantly (we aim for around 50% in your first year) while giving developers fast, reliable feedback on every merge request. This is a hands\-on CI/CD role inside engineering, not an infrastructure DevOps role. You will spend most of your time optimising builds and pipelines, and a smaller share keeping them running.
  
  

Key Initiatives
  
  

**Reduce Pipeline Time:**  

Map the critical path, remove waiting between jobs, cut per\-job overhead (clone, artifact download, restore) and cancel redundant pipelines automatically.
  
  

**Job Strategy:**  

**Decide what runs where and when:** fast merge request checks, fuller runs on main and release branches, and complete nightly runs. Group short jobs, split long ones and parallelise long system test suites.
  
  

**Tests in the Pipeline:**  

With the test architect, place each test type in the right pipeline tier, select tests by change where safe, quarantine flaky tests and move coverage runs to scheduled pipelines.
  
  

**Release Pipelines:**  

Make release and cherry\-pick pipelines fast and predictable so fixes reach customers quickly.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Build Performance:**  

Profile and optimise MSBuild\-based builds for C\#/.NET Framework 4\.7 and C\+\+: incremental and parallel builds, NuGet and dependency caching, and removal of bottlenecks.
  
  

**Pipeline Design:**  

Design, standardise and maintain reusable GitLab CI pipeline templates (.gitlab\-ci.yml, DAGs, multi\-project pipelines) across C\#, C\+\+ and Python repositories.
  
  

**Test \& Verification Integration:**  

With the test architect, development and QA/verification leads, embed unit tests, static analysis (Coverity, SonarQube) and automated test bench runs into CI, with clear results reporting. Agree jointly with the test architect which suites run in each pipeline tier.
  
  

**Pipeline Reliability \& Metrics:**  

Investigate failures, remove flaky builds and tests, and track build time, failure rate and pipeline uptime on dashboards to show improvement.
  
  

**Pipeline Operations:**  

Act as first line on the engineering side when pipelines or runners go down: diagnose, restart or re\-run jobs, unblock developers, and hand infrastructure issues to IT\-DevOps with a clear diagnosis.
  
  

**Capacity Input:**  

Give IT\-DevOps data\-backed requirements for build runners and test environments, based on queue times and job durations.
  
  

**Artifact \& Release Automation:**  

Automate versioning, release packaging, artifact staging and package registry management.
  
  

**Developer Workflow:**  

Advise teams on branching and merge strategies, merge request verification gates and fast feedback loops.
  
  

**Scope:**  

GitLab runner management, AWS/cloud infrastructure and GitLab platform administration are owned by the IT\-DevOps team. This role works with them on requirements and issues but does not own that infrastructure. It is their engineering\-side point of contact: first line when pipelines are down, and input on sizing what we need.
  
  

Job requirements
  
  

**Required Qualifications \& Skills:**  

**Experience:**  

5\+ years in CI/CD, build engineering or release automation for multi\-repository C\#/.NET and C\+\+ codebases.
  
  

**Build Systems:**  

Deep hands\-on experience with MSBuild and .NET Framework 4\.x builds on Windows; experience with C\+\+ builds (MSBuild/CMake).
  
  

**CI/CD Platform:**  

**Strong GitLab CI/CD skills:** pipeline authoring, DAGs, multi\-project pipelines, caching and artifact management.
  
  

**Scripting:**  

Strong PowerShell and Python for pipeline logic, build orchestration and log analysis; our build also includes Python\-based simulation.
  
  

**Test Execution in CI:**  

Experience splitting, grouping and parallelising long\-running test suites, and detecting and managing flaky tests.
  
  

**Containers:**  

Working knowledge of Docker for build and test jobs.
  
  

**Problem\-Solving \& Communication:**  

Able to root\-cause complex build, link and test integration failures; clear, fluent English for working across regions.
  
  

Preferred/ Good to Have
  
  

Experience in semiconductor equipment, high\-tech machine automation, or hardware/software integration environments.
  
  

Hands\-on use of Coverity, SonarQube and test management tools (Xray, Jira).
  
  

Experience with build acceleration or distributed build tools.
  
  

Experience migrating old\-style .csproj projects to SDK\-style.
  
  

WHAT WE CAN OFFER
  
  

Our employees are our strength and together we want to achieve the maximum. That is why we invest a lot in our employees, through generous development budgets and personal attention. According to our employees, this is what makes the difference at Sioux. We are proud of that. For us, success is more than just a good salary: it is also about feeling valued, getting responsibilities, and to be able continuously develop oneself.
  
  

No matter how experienced you are, you will continue to develop yourself on a personal level and in terms of content. You have a personal training budget of 5,000 SGD available for this, every year.
  
  

Varied work due to the diversity in technologies, markets, and projects
  
  

An open culture that focuses on collaboration, learning, and having fun
  
  

An innovative work environment
  
  

Job Location
  
  

Our office is conveniently located next to the
  
  

Tai Seng MRT station.
  
  

Sioux Technologies is a high\-tech services and solutions provider, headquartered in Eindhoven, the Netherlands with R\&D centers in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, China, Singapore and Vietnam.
  
  

We have a track record in the development of Medical, Traffic, Transport and Infrastructure, Semiconductor, Automotive and Agrotech smart solutions for more than 24 years.
  
  

Our 750 engineers generated a turnover of more than USD 100 Mil in 2019\. Over 60% are software focus. We have end to end capabilities from POC to early production stage.
  
  

With vast competencies in the areas of Mathware, multidisciplinary and multiple industry domain knowledge, as well as pure/applied research bridging experience, the company is looking to offer its technological expertise to MNCs or SMEs of all sizes.
