jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Digify is a cloud\-based document security and data room platform used by over 800,000 professionals across 138 countries to protect sensitive documents and control how they are accessed, shared, and tracked.
  
  

We’re building the next generation of secure document infrastructure across browsers, cloud storage, email, web, and mobile platforms — helping organizations maintain control over sensitive information after it leaves their hands.
  
  

**Our engineering team works on systems involving:**  

secure document delivery and viewing
  
  

authentication and access control
  
  

encryption and file handling
  
  

browser and cloud integrations
  
  

scalable backend services and analytics
  
  

We’re looking for an engineer who has strong software engineering fundamentals, enjoys building real\-world production systems, and is adaptable to evolving development workflows, including AI\-assisted and agentic coding tools.
  
  

What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

Design, build, and maintain features across our document security platform
  
  

Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  

Work across backend and frontend systems, with opportunities to contribute to browser integrations and mobile\-related functionality
  
  

Develop systems related to authentication, access control, file delivery, and secure document handling
  
  

Contribute to APIs, integrations, background workers, and analytics pipelines
  
  

Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ship reliable, maintainable software
  
  

Debug and resolve production issues and technical problems.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  
  

3–6 years of software engineering experience, including experience working on production systems
  
  

Strong fundamentals in software engineering, algorithms, and system design
  
  

Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks
  
  

Experience with .Net Framework and C\#
  
  

Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
  
  

Comfortable contributing across both frontend and backend systems, while being stronger in one area
  
  

Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and technical judgment
  
  

Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code
  
  

Comfortable working in evolving product and technical environments with changing requirements and priorities
  
  

Openness to modern development workflows, including AI\-assisted and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
  
  

**Nice\-to\-have:**  

Experience with security, encryption, authentication, or access control systems
  
  

Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, or event\-driven architectures
  
  

Experience with browser extensions, mobile apps, or file\-heavy systems
  
  

Experience integrating with third\-party APIs and cloud platforms (Google, AWS, etc.)
  
  

Experience with automated testing and modern software development practices.
  
  

**Why Join Digify:**  

Work on technically challenging security and file\-platform problems
  
  

Be part of an experienced and collaborative engineering team
  
  

Build products used by organizations around the world
  
  

Take ownership of meaningful systems and product areas
  
  

Digify is a cloud\-based document security and data room software that allows customers to control, protect and track important documents after sharing them. Companies use Digify to protect confidential information for fundraising and due diligence, secure intellectual property, and protect sensitive communications.
  
  

Digify is used in 138 countries today. We have more than 600,000 users worldwide.
  
  

Learn more about Digify by visiting our website (https://digify.com).

jobs.title: SQA Engineer - fixed term
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


In Thermo Fisher Scientific Brno, we develop and produce high\-tech electron microscopes and spectrometers. Our devices are involved in research of SARS\-CoV\-2 virus or enable mobile phones to get smaller. Our work contributes to making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We are the most prominent production site of electron microscopes worldwide, following a tradition of over 70 years long. There are many experts in physics, electronics, software, mechanical engineering, and logistics among us.


At the Sample Prep and Analysis (SPA) group, we develop and maintain software solutions that automate the operation of Scanning Electron Microscopes (SEMs). Our technology enables customers in the semiconductor industry to identify manufacturing defects, accelerate research, and improve the reliability, performance, and energy efficiency of next\-generation semiconductor devices.

**What will you be working on?**


We are looking for a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to help deliver high\-quality software across our product portfolio.


In this role, you will work closely with software engineers, product owners, system architects, and domain experts to ensure our software meets high standards of reliability, performance, and user experience. You will contribute to quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle, design and execute test strategies, develop and maintain automated tests, and help identify opportunities to improve testing processes and product quality.


This is an exciting opportunity to work with software that controls highly sophisticated scientific instruments with nanometer precision in an international R\&D environment. You will apply modern quality engineering practices, leverage test automation and AI\-assisted testing approaches, and contribute to the robustness of software that supports the development and production of the world’s most advanced semiconductor chips and memory technologies.

**Responsibilities:**

* Participating on all phases of product development cycle as SQA engineer.
* Support agile team in collaboration, problem solving, so that team can deliver high quality, innovative software on time.
* Develop and sustain relationships with vendors and joint development partners that support and accelerate the team’s development activities.
* Guard the software quality, development processes and their implementation in the organisation.
* Verifying accurate functionality of product features
* Verifying bug fixes
* Maintaining test scenario documentation
* Preparing SQA recommendation reports
* Identify risks during execution and help with their mitigation.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in related field required
* 3\+ years in agile software development
* Experience with software development process

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Strong written and verbal communications skills
* Ability to use data and metrics to identify and address problems and drive continuous improvement
* Focus on quality and robustness
* Python expertise
* Desire and ability to work in an international context and diverse R\&D team that is multi\-disciplinary
* **Highly motivated** teammate with a strong desire for continuous learning and broadening knowledge base.
* A love of science and a desire for continuous learning
* **Desire to learn how to work with high\-end hardware equipment**
* Experience with API testing, including RESTful services and tools such as Swagger / OpenAPI
* Solid understanding of general web application testing principles (functional, regression, exploratory)
* Practical knowledge of at least one web automation framework or test driver, such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress

**What technologies are we using?**

* We are using C\#, .NET standard, Python
* We are developing applications for Windows
* For regression testing we use Robot Framework
* For Dev\-Ops we are using GitLab environment and Jira for bug tracking
* For image processing and AI we use OpenCV
* Other technologies we are using Elastic stack, Docker, Kubernetes

**How do we empower you?**

* Flexible working schedule
* Hackerspace room equipped with VR headset, Recording studio for your videos, music or podcasts, Lego Mindstorms, 3D printer, Arduino and much more!
* You will be part of a successful international company specializing in high\-tech
* Great working equipment: notebook and two monitors are our standards, further office equipment based on personal preferences
* Meal allowance and company canteen with free fruit and vegetables
* Modern work environment including relax zones, gym, outside playground and massages in the building
* Open and friendly company spirit \- we have a company rock band, various sports teams etc.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Internship Opportunities
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

**Your internship:**
--------------------

**Location: Microsoft Romania****Duration: 12 weeks, full\-time****Start: July 2027****Work model: On\-site**

What if your internship project didn't sit on the sidelines, but contributed to the infrastructure behind one of the world's largest cloud platforms? At Microsoft, interns work on real\-world projects with teams across the world. You'll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment, learn quickly, contribute ideas, and make an impact from the start.
Azure Core builds the foundational infrastructure and platform capabilities that power Microsoft Azure. As a Software Engineering Intern with Azure Core, you'll join engineering teams working on the foundational technologies behind Microsoft Azure. You'll have the opportunity to solve real engineering problems, write production\-quality software, learn from experienced engineers, and see how systems are designed and operated at cloud scale. Our engineering teams work across areas such as compute, networking, storage, cloud\-native technologies, fleet management, operating systems, virtualization, and distributed systems, creating the foundation on which customers build and run applications and increasingly demanding AI workloads.
Depending on your project and team, you could contribute to challenges involving cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, system reliability, performance, security, automation, or AI\-enabled engineering experiences.
If you're curious about what happens underneath the cloud and want to understand how software operates at global scale, Azure Core is an extraordinary place to start your engineering career.### **Applications Are Open!**


We encourage interested candidates to **apply as soon as possible**, as **roles are limited** and highly competitive.

  


Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Every day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

**Responsibilities**  

**As a Software Engineering Intern,** you will:* Apply software engineering principles and creative problem\-solving to real technical challenges.
* Partner with engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and help turn ideas into working software.
* Design, write, review, test, and debug maintainable code.
* Learn new engineering technologies, methods, and tools and apply them to your project.
* Seek feedback and use engineering best practices to continuously improve your solutions.
* Work collaboratively while owning your deliverables and managing your project effectively.
* Explore opportunities to improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, performance, and security of the systems you work on.
* Learn how modern engineering teams use AI and automation to improve how software is designed, built, tested, and operated.

  

**Qualifications**  

### **✅** **Required Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field with least one semester or academic term remaining after completing the internship.
* Programming experience in at least one language such as C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Python, or another object\-oriented programming language.
* Strong foundation in computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
* You must be legally authorized to work in Romania to be eligible for this role. (Legally authorized \= has citizenship or has been granted a valid visa or work permit).
* You communicate confidently in English, written and spoken — you'll work every day with teammates across Romania and around the world.
* **Preferred Qualifications**


We're particularly interested in students who bring one or more of the following:* Exposure to cloud computing, distributed systems, operating systems, networking, virtualization, or storage through coursework, research, personal projects, hackathons, open source, or previous internships.
* Experience building software projects individually or as part of a team.
* Exposure to AI/ML or AI\-assisted software development, whether through projects, coursework, APIs, models, or developer tools.
* Curiosity, strong problem\-solving skills, a growth mindset, and enthusiasm for learning how complex systems work.


You don't need to know everything before joining us. We're looking for people with strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn.  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

jobs.title: Civil Site Engineer in Bulgaria - Επιβλέπων Μηχανικός Εργοταξίου στην Βουλγαρία
jobs.description:
**CIVIL SITE ENGINEER / WORKS SUPERVISOR**

  

  

**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Projects Across Bulgaria**

  

  

**www.group\-egnatia.bg**

  

**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**

  

  

**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**

  

  

Egnatia Bulgaria, part of the Egnatia Group, is an international EPC contractor providing Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) and Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across the energy, infrastructure, telecommunications, industrial, commercial and residential sectors.

  

  

With more than 25 years of presence in Southeast Europe, we deliver technically demanding projects with a strong focus on quality, safety, reliability and engineering excellence.

  

  

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for Civil Site Engineers / Works Supervisors to join our project teams throughout Bulgaria.

  

  

The position is suitable both for engineers who already have site supervision experience and for motivated professionals who want to further develop their career in construction and project execution within an international EPC environment.

  

  

**The Role**

  

  

You will be responsible for the on\-site supervision and coordination of civil works across a variety of Egnatia Bulgaria projects, including energy and renewable energy projects, infrastructure, industrial facilities, buildings and commercial or residential fit\-outs.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

* On\-site supervision of civil construction activities.
* Supervision of earthworks, excavations, grading and site preparation.
* Supervision of concrete works, foundations and structural works.
* Supervision of roads, drainage systems, fencing and associated infrastructure works.
* Supervision of civil and architectural works in building and fit\-out projects, where applicable.
* Coordination and daily follow\-up of subcontractors, site crews and suppliers.
* Verification that works are executed according to drawings, technical specifications and project requirements.
* Monitoring of quantities, productivity, quality and construction progress.
* Identification and reporting of technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordination with Project Managers, engineers, designers and other project disciplines.
* Monitoring compliance with site HSE and quality requirements.
* Preparation of daily/weekly progress updates, site records, photographic documentation and technical reports.

  

  

**Requirements**

  

  

* Degree in Civil Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Previous construction/site experience will be considered an advantage; the level of responsibility will be adapted to the candidate’s experience.
* Good command of English, written and spoken, is required.
* Knowledge of Bulgarian will be considered a strong asset.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings and specifications.
* Good organisational, communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary project team.
* Willingness to work on and travel between project sites throughout Bulgaria.
* Valid Category B driving licence.

  

  

**What We Offer**

  

  

* Net monthly salary: **€1,500–€2,500**, depending on experience, qualifications and level of responsibility.
* Accommodation provided in the vicinity the projects
* Company vehicle according to the requirements of the position.
* Laptop and mobile phone.
* Access to modern site supervision and engineering tools, including surveying GPS equipment, drones and digital reporting tools.
* Continuous training and hands\-on technical development.
* Strong engineering and technical support from experienced project teams.
* Exposure to different types and scales of EPC projects.
* Opportunities for increased responsibility and long\-term career development within the Egnatia Group.

  

  

**Location**

  

  

The position is based on project sites throughout **Bulgaria.** Accommodation and transportation support are provided according to project requirements.

  

  

**Join Our Team**

  

  

If you are interested in developing your career through hands\-on involvement in challenging engineering and construction projects, we would like to hear from you.

  

  

  

**ΕΠΙΒΛΕΠΩΝ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ – ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΟΣ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ (CIVIL SITE ENGINEER)**

  

  

**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Έργα σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία**

  

  

**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**

  

  

**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**

  

  

Η **Egnatia Bulgaria**, μέλος του **Egnatia Group**, είναι διεθνής **EPC Contractor**, παρέχοντας ολοκληρωμένες υπηρεσίες Engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC) καθώς και Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) στους τομείς της ενέργειας, των υποδομών, των τηλεπικοινωνιών, των βιομηχανικών, εμπορικών και οικιστικών έργων.

  

  

Με περισσότερα από 25 χρόνια παρουσίας στη Νοτιοανατολική Ευρώπη, υλοποιούμε τεχνικά απαιτητικά έργα με ιδιαίτερη έμφαση στην ποιότητα, την ασφάλεια, την αξιοπιστία και την τεχνική αρτιότητα.

  

  

Στο πλαίσιο της συνεχούς ανάπτυξής μας, αναζητούμε Πολιτικούς Μηχανικούς για επίβλεψη εργασιών εργοταξίου (Civil Site Engineers / Works Supervisors), οι οποίοι θα ενταχθούν στις ομάδες έργων μας σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία.

  

  

Η θέση απευθύνεται τόσο σε μηχανικούς με εμπειρία στην επίβλεψη εργοταξιακών εργασιών όσο και σε μηχανικούς με μικρότερη εμπειρία, οι οποίοι επιθυμούν να εξελιχθούν επαγγελματικά στον τομέα των κατασκευών και της υλοποίησης έργων σε ένα διεθνές EPC περιβάλλον.

  

  

**Ο Ρόλος**

  

  

Ο/Η μηχανικός θα είναι υπεύθυνος/η για την επιτόπου επίβλεψη και τον συντονισμό εργασιών πολιτικού μηχανικού σε διαφορετικούς τύπους έργων της Egnatia Bulgaria, όπως έργα ενέργειας και Ανανεώσιμων Πηγών Ενέργειας, υποδομών, βιομηχανικών εγκαταστάσεων, κτιριακών έργων καθώς και εμπορικών και οικιστικών fit\-out projects.

  

  

**Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες**

  

  

* Επιτόπου επίβλεψη εργασιών πολιτικού μηχανικού.
* Επίβλεψη χωματουργικών εργασιών, εκσκαφών, διαμορφώσεων και προετοιμασίας εργοταξίου.
* Επίβλεψη εργασιών σκυροδέματος, θεμελιώσεων και δομικών κατασκευών.
* Επίβλεψη οδοποιίας, αποστραγγιστικών έργων, περιφράξεων και συναφών έργων υποδομής.
* Επίβλεψη οικοδομικών και αρχιτεκτονικών εργασιών σε κτιριακά και fit\-out έργα, όπου απαιτείται.
* Συντονισμός και καθημερινή παρακολούθηση υπεργολάβων, συνεργείων και προμηθευτών.
* Έλεγχος της εκτέλεσης των εργασιών σύμφωνα με τα σχέδια, τις τεχνικές προδιαγραφές και τις απαιτήσεις του έργου.
* Παρακολούθηση ποσοτήτων, παραγωγικότητας, ποιότητας και προόδου των εργασιών.
* Εντοπισμός και αναφορά τεχνικών θεμάτων ή προβλημάτων του εργοταξίου.
* Συνεργασία και συντονισμός με Project Managers, μηχανικούς, μελετητές και τις υπόλοιπες ειδικότητες του έργου.
* Παρακολούθηση της συμμόρφωσης με τις απαιτήσεις Υγείας \& Ασφάλειας (HSE) και Ποιότητας.
* Προετοιμασία ημερήσιων και εβδομαδιαίων αναφορών προόδου, αρχείων εργοταξίου, φωτογραφικής τεκμηρίωσης και τεχνικών reports.

  

  

**Απαραίτητα Προσόντα**

  

  

* Πτυχίο Πολιτικού Μηχανικού ή συναφούς τεχνικής ειδικότητας.
* Προηγούμενη εμπειρία σε κατασκευαστικά έργα ή/και εργοτάξιο θα θεωρηθεί επιπλέον προσόν. Το επίπεδο ευθύνης της θέσης θα προσαρμόζεται ανάλογα με την εμπειρία του υποψηφίου.
* Απαραίτητη η καλή γνώση Αγγλικών, σε γραπτό και προφορικό επίπεδο.
* Η γνώση Βουλγαρικών θα θεωρηθεί σημαντικό πρόσθετο προσόν.
* Ικανότητα ανάγνωσης και κατανόησης τεχνικών σχεδίων και προδιαγραφών.
* Καλές οργανωτικές, επικοινωνιακές και πρακτικές δεξιότητες επίλυσης προβλημάτων.
* Ικανότητα αποτελεσματικής συνεργασίας στο πλαίσιο διεπιστημονικής ομάδας έργου.
* Δυνατότητα εργασίας και μετακίνησης μεταξύ εργοταξίων σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία.
* Άδεια οδήγησης κατηγορίας Β.

  

  

**Τι Προσφέρουμε**

  

  

* Καθαρές μηνιαίες αποδοχές **€1\.500–€2\.500**, ανάλογα με την εμπειρία, τα προσόντα και το επίπεδο ευθύνης.
* Παροχή διαμονής στην ευρύτερη περιοχή του εκάστοτε έργου.
* Εταιρικό όχημα, ανάλογα με τις απαιτήσεις της θέσης.
* Laptop και κινητό τηλέφωνο.
* Πρόσβαση σε σύγχρονο εξοπλισμό και τεχνολογίες επίβλεψης έργων, όπως τοπογραφικά GPS, drones και ψηφιακά εργαλεία reporting.
* Συνεχής εκπαίδευση και πρακτική τεχνική εξέλιξη.
* Ισχυρή τεχνική και μηχανολογική υποστήριξη από έμπειρες ομάδες έργων.
* Συμμετοχή σε διαφορετικού τύπου και κλίμακας EPC projects.
* Δυνατότητα ανάληψης αυξημένων αρμοδιοτήτων και μακροχρόνιας επαγγελματικής εξέλιξης εντός του Egnatia Group.

  

  

**Τόπος Εργασίας**

  

  

Η θέση αφορά εργοτάξια σε όλη τη **Βουλγαρία**. Παρέχεται διαμονή και υποστήριξη μετακίνησης ανάλογα με τις απαιτήσεις και την τοποθεσία του εκάστοτε έργου.

  

  

**Join Our Team**

  

  

Εάν επιθυμείτε να εξελίξετε την επαγγελματική σας πορεία μέσα από ενεργή συμμετοχή σε απαιτητικά τεχνικά και κατασκευαστικά έργα, θα χαρούμε να σας γνωρίσουμε.

  

  

Σας ευχαριστούμε για τον χρόνο σας

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
Software Engineer

**Location:** Houthalen \| **Department:** Engineering \| **Reports to:** Head of Engineering

**Purpose of the role**

To ensure the industrial automation of the production machines, covering both their control software and their electrical design. The role combines PLC programming and electrical engineering with hands\-on customer support. That includes guiding customers through their automation projects, starting up machines at their sites and training their operators.

**Position in the organization:**

The Software Engineer reports directly to the Head of the Engineering Department.

Responsibilities and authorities

* Develop the electrical schematics of the machines in EPLAN and keep them up to date
* Develop and adapt PLC software for industrial machines
* Provide customers and field technicians with support through remote support programs
* Start up machines at the customer's site and train operators on location
* Upgrade and optimize existing programs and electrical schematics for production machines to improve their performance
* Consult with customers and guide them through the industrial automation of their projects
* Assist customers with any questions relating to the automation of their machines

**Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking
* Solution\-oriented approach to problems
* Flexible and customer\-focused mindset
* Proactive, takes initiative
* Willing to keep learning through further training
* Enterprising
* Able to work independently
* Strong organizational skills
* Stress\-resistant, composed under pressure
* Willing to travel for the job
* Team player

**Job requirements:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in industrial engineering, preferably in Automation, or an equivalent level gained through experience and relevant knowledge of automation
* Knowledge of industrial automation and PLC programming, preferably with Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 or TwinCAT 2 and SEW, using Structured Text and FBD
* Knowledge of EPLAN and of drawing electrical schematics
* General knowledge of electrical engineering, in particular drives
* Knowledge of Visual Studio C\#.NET is a plus, but not a requirement
* Willingness to travel when customer needs require it
* Knowledge of Dutch and English; other languages are a plus

**Location: Houthalen, Belgium**

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Language:

* English (Preferred)
* Dutch (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
Backend Developer .NET
Junior/medior AI-Augmented Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacature titel
Junior/medior AI\-Augmented Software Engineer
Beschrijving
Rf\-Technologies is Europees marktleider in brandwerende oplossingen voor de bouwsector. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Oosterzele beschermen onze producten gebouwen — ziekenhuizen, hotels, winkelcentra — in meer dan 30 landen. We groeien jaar na jaar, gedreven door continue R\&D\-investeringen, en zijn een familiebedrijf dat snel beslist.


Verantwoordelijkheden
We zijn een jaar geleden gestart met AI\-agents echt inzetten in onze development flow — niet als hype, maar als een productiemiddel. Vandaag draait dat op een eigen opgezette workflow rond Claude Code: gespecialiseerde agents die een module autonoom door analyse, bouw (data/business/API/frontend), review, security\-check en delivery loodsen, met een eigen kennisvault die alle architectuurbeslissingen, geleerde patronen en migratiestatus bijhoudt. Als Functional Analyst / Developer stap je in dat systeem in en bouw je het mee verder uit.


* Je analyseert functionele vragen en bugs, brengt de root cause in kaart en vertaalt dit naar een concreet ontwerp — net als vandaag.
* Je bouwt features in een .NET\-omgeving (C\#, 3\-lagen architectuur) met een Vue 3 / TypeScript frontend, en denkt mee na over architectuur en schaalbaarheid op Azure.
* Je werkt met AI\-agents als collega's, niet als autocomplete: je zet ze in om functionele analyses, migraties en reviews te versnellen, controleert hun werk kritisch, en stuurt bij waar nodig.
* Je helpt mee de interne AI\-workflow zelf verder uitbouwen — nieuwe agent\-rollen, betere kennisopbouw, bredere toepassing binnen het team en de organisatie.
* Je bepaalt samen met stakeholders prioriteiten op de roadmap van onze interne platformen.
Kwalificaties
* Bachelor of master IT, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
* Ervaring als developer in .NET / C\#; kennis van TypeScript (Vue, React, Angular — het framework zelf is minder belangrijk dan het denkpatroon) is een plus.
* Je kan zelfstandig een functionele vraag ontleden tot een technisch plan — en dat plan ook uitvoeren.
* Nieuwsgierig naar AI\-gedreven development: je hebt al met AI\-coding\-tools gewerkt of wil je je er snel in verdiepen, en behoudt een kritische blik op wat een agent aflevert.
* Analytisch, nauwkeurig, en niet bang om vragen te stellen aan de business wanneer een requirement niet klopt.
* Nederlands en Engels vloeiend.
Baan voordelen
40\-urenweek met glijdende uren* 12 ADV\-dagen.

jobs.title: .Net FullStack Developer
jobs.description:
**Environnement de travail**


L’Office des Étrangers est en pleine modernisation numérique de ses processus internes. Dans le cadre du programme eMigration, il travaille à la mise en place d’un environnement de travail numérique intégré et tourné vers l’avenir.


Afin de renforcer ce programme, nous recherchons un **.Net FullStack Developer**, passionné par la transformation numérique et doté d’un sens aigu de la collaboration avec les différentes équipes.


**Description de fonction**


L’Office des Étrangers utilise actuellement des applications développées en .Net, C\# et Angular.


Vous travaillerez sur un gigantesque projet qui s’inscrit dans le cadre du programme transversal eMigration qui comprend différents projets visant chacun à numériser une partie de la procédure globale d’asile et de migration, en tenant compte des normes générales fixées dans l’architecture eMigration.


**Vos tâches en tant que FullStack Developer**


* Vous êtes intégré dans une équipe en charge du projet de développement. Vous participez activement aux réunions prévues dans le cadre de ce projet. Votre expérience vous permet d’intervenir dans l’élaboration du planning de développement.
* Vous développez la partie back\-end et la partie front\-end en respectant les standards et normes qui sont appliqués dans le cadre du programme eMigration.
* Vous livrez des applications construites sur base d’un code de qualité irréprochable.
* Vous implémentez la solution de synchronisation sur base du design élaboré en collaboration avec les différents membres de votre équipe
* Vous respectez strictement les échéances définies avec vous.
* Vous assurez la documentation détaillée de la solution que vous développez en collaboration avec votre équipe
* Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe de développeurs internes et vous assurez le transfert de connaissances des parties que vous développez.
* Vous participez activement à l’intégration au sein de la plateforme eMigration des API développées.
* Vous définissez des scénarios de tests automatisés.
  

  

**Description de profil**


* Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bachelor en informatique ou disposez d’une expérience équivalente.
* Vous démontrez au moins 5 années d’expérience dans le développement de solutions « Web based », et plus particulièrement des API back\-end, ainsi que 5 années d’expérience en développement .Net.
* Vous avez une excellente connaissance de :
	+ .NET
	+ C\#
	+ Angular
	+ Oracle / MS\-SQL
	+ Agile / Scrum
	+ Azure DevOps
	+ Microservices, Kubernetes et Docker
* Vous êtes organisé, structuré et autonome.
* Vous êtes animé par un fort esprit d’équipe et êtes orienté solution.
* Vous êtes francophone et avez de très bonnes connaissances en anglais. Vous connaissez suffisamment bien le néerlandais pour pouvoir suivre des réunions dans cette langue, le cas échéant.

**Nous offrons**


Notre gouvernement fédéral est en pleine transformation digitale, des défis de la cybersécurité à la communication numérique, des améliorations du réseau pour soutenir notre nouvelle façon de travailler aux projets de développement complexes et à l’optimisation des applications existantes. Vous souhaitez participer à ce processus et créer une valeur ajoutée sociétale, tout en travaillant à votre développement personnel et en allant au bout de vos ambitions ?


Nous vous offrons un contrat à durée indéterminée assorti d’un objectif clair dans un environnement stimulant et un package salarial très compétitif assorti d’une série d’avantages extralégaux et d’un budget mobilité (assurance hospitalisation, télétravail, chèques\-repas, mobilité, fonds de pension, etc.). Nous attachons également une grande importance à un équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée et nos bureaux sont facilement accessibles par les transports publics.

jobs.title: Project Engineer/Scientist - Radiation (SY-STI-BMP-2026-235-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

RADNEXT 2030 is a Horizon Europe Research Infrastructure Services project that provides coordinated transnational access to radiation effects testing facilities across Europe and beyond. CERN is the project coordinator and also operates two key facilities within the network: CHARM and HEARTS@CERN. This position is embedded in the Radiation to Electronics (R2E) activity within the Accelerator Systems department. You will work at the interface between project management, user access operations, and radiation effects research, contributing to the successful delivery of RADNEXT 2030's objectives. You will gain broad exposure to the European radiation hardness assurance community, to CERN's accelerator infrastructure, and to the design, execution and analysis of radiation effects experiments.

**Your responsibilities**

* Contribute to the definition and coordination of the transnational access workflow for facilities within the RADNEXT 2030 framework.
* Contribute to the definition, testing and improvement of the facility access online portal.
* Provide scientific support to the organisation and delivery of RADNEXT 2030 consortium activities.
* Support the scientific communication, dissemination and outreach activities of RADNEXT 2030\.
* Contribute to applied research tasks, with a focus on novel testing techniques and radiation environment characterisation.
* Support the integration of the HEARTS@CERN facility and its related user management into the RADNEXT 2030 consortium.
* Engage with the broader radiation effects community through the RADNEXT 2030 user base, supporting training activities including the Radiation Effects Testing Summer School.


More information here: https://radnext.web.cern.ch/

**Your profile**

* Some familiarity with radiation effects testing and radiation hardness assurance, gained through studies, a thesis, internships or professional experience.
* Initial experience in the design, preparation or execution of irradiation experiments would be an advantage.
* Some experience in scientific writing and presenting results, for example through a thesis, reports or conference contributions.
* Familiarity with project coordination, user support or scientific service activities would be an advantage.


Skills

* Basic knowledge of radiation effects in electronics; familiarity with the main radiation test standards and methodologies (e.g. ESA/ECSS, MIL\-STD) would be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of particle accelerator facilities and radiation\-matter interaction physics relevant to radiation effects testing.
* Ability to work in an international, multi\-institutional project environment and to interact with a diverse user community.
* Good organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines with appropriate guidance.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Applied Physics, Electronics Engineering (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  

**Additional Information**  

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-November\-2026


This position involves:

* Work in Radiation Areas.
* Stand\-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
* Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: SY\-STI\-BMP\-2026\-235\-GRAE


Field of work: Applied Physics


Benchmark job: 200140 \- Applied Physicist

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.

  

If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.

**The role**

  

As a Senior Data Engineer, you are a key player in designing, implementing, and maintaining data pipelines and architectures. You work closely with clients to understand their data needs and realise tailored solutions that drive business insights. Your technical expertise and strong methodology help you bring your projects and clients to success.

 **How you’ll make an impact**

  

* Whether in the cloud or an on\-premises data center, you expertly navigate the world of Big Data, helping our clients make their data business\- or operations\-ready.
* You access diverse data sources efficiently and reproducibly.
* You design, test, and monitor distributed data processing pipelines.
* You work closely with data scientists in the creation of machine learning models.
* You perform performance and cost estimations for various use cases.
* You develop and create meaningful dashboards to visualize processed data.

 **What’s important to us**

  

* You are comfortable with Big Data, massively scalable databases, cloud infrastructures, and distributed algorithms.
* You have a passion for sustainable software development and have gathered several years of experience in technical roles.
* Along with your expertise in Python and SQL, you ideally have hands\-on experience or a strong interest in technologies such as Hadoop, Apache Spark, Hive, Airflow, RDBMS, NoSQL, DevOps, Kubernetes, and Java or .NET
* You have a good understanding of the capabilities in large public cloud environments and may have used resources from Amazon AWS, MS Azure, or Google’s GCP.
* You hold a university degree (ETH, Uni, FH) in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a similar field.
* Fluency in both German and English is required for this position.

 **What we offer**

* **Work life blend:** we offer a safe \& healthy workplace, with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
* **Profit share scheme:** In addition to your annual salary, you may receive a profit share defined by the company’s success in the previous year.
* **Global and Diverse Zühlke community:** witness how colleagues from all our offices across the globe come together to create a unique, positive and inclusive work culture, learning from one another at annual team camps, and celebrating year\-end parties and other local festivities.
* **Committed to development:** we are committed to the growth of our people and are investing in your development. We’re empowering you to build the skills you need to make a positive impact, both personally and for our clients, today and in the future.

  

If you feel you don't meet all the requirements, we are still happy to get to know you, learn more about your ambitions and ideas and look forward to receiving your application!  



  

We welcome people from all backgrounds, regardless of their gender, personality, national origin, race, religion, colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability or veteran status.

* Identity Lifecycle, Provisioning \& Deprovisioning.
* LDAP, REST APIs, SCIM, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* **Git/GitLab**, Docker, Ansible, Bruno.

Profile:


* Hands\-on experience in **IAM / Ping Identity** technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with L1/L2 operational experience.
* Experience across development, project implementation, and production support activities.
* **Fluent professional English** and experience working with international teams.

* Knowledge of banking and banking processes will be an asset.
* Business logic knowledge and IT Relations.

* Ability to understand, explain, and support solution evolutions.
* Ability to meet objectives / Result orientation.
* With attention to detail/ Rigorous.
* Collaboration and teamwork.
* Problem/incident resolution.
* Client focused.
* Effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Proactivity.

LANGUAGES


English level B2 or higher.

* Training programs, career plans and internal mobility opportunities, national and international thanks to our presence in different countries.
* Diversity and Inclusion Committee that ensures an inclusive work environment. In recent years, several employee communities have been created to organize diversity and inclusion awareness actions (PRIDE, We Generations and MixCity).

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer · AI & Agentic Development
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer · AI \& Agentic Development

Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con sólida experiencia en desarrollo web, mobile y cloud, y especial interés en la aplicación de IA y agentes al proceso de desarrollo de software.

Funciones:

Desarrollo y evolución de aplicaciones Web con React y aplicaciones mobile con React Native, junto con APIs y servicios backend. Diseño e implementación de arquitecturas cloud sobre AWS, especialmente Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, EC2 y CloudWatch, además de otros servicios habituales de AWS.

Participación en todo el ciclo de desarrollo, incluyendo arquitectura, programación, integración, testing automatizado, CI/CD, revisión y calidad del código.

Se busca experiencia o interés avanzado en AI\-assisted Development / Agentic Coding, utilizando herramientas como Claude Code, Cursor, Codex u otras equivalentes. Se valorará especialmente la capacidad para orquestar varios agentes especializados en análisis, programación, testing, revisión, documentación y refactoring, integrándolos en un proceso de desarrollo controlado y automatizado.

Perfil técnico:

Experiencia senior en React, React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, APIs REST, Git y testing automatizado, así como experiencia práctica en AWS y conocimientos de arquitectura, seguridad, escalabilidad y CI/CD.

Se valorará experiencia con herramientas como Jest/Vitest, Playwright/Cypress, React Testing Library, AWS SAM/CDK/CloudFormation y sistemas de automatización y calidad de código.

Se valorará adicionalmente:

Experiencia en Unity/C\#, Unreal Engine, 3D, XR o desarrollo interactivo.

Formación:

Preferiblemente Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería del Software o equivalente. Se valorará disponer de Máster universitario en desarrollo de software/ingeniería informática y especialmente formación de posgrado o Máster oficial en Inteligencia Artificial, así como titulaciones de experto o especializaciones acreditadas en IA aplicada al desarrollo, LLMs o sistemas multiagente.

Buscamos:

Un perfil con autonomía y capacidad de decisión técnica, orientación a la calidad, pensamiento crítico y capacidad para utilizar la IA como parte integral del proceso de ingeniería, no únicamente como herramienta de generación de código.

Sueldo: 28\.000,00€\-32\.000,00€ al año

Beneficios:

* Flexibilidad horaria
* Jornada intensiva en verano
* Jornada intensiva los viernes

Ubicación del trabajo: Empleo remoto

jobs.title: Desarrollador/a de Software – ERP e Integraciones
jobs.description:
En **Recambios Frain** buscamos incorporar una persona al equipo de IT para ayudarnos a avanzar en nuevos desarrollos, mejorar aplicaciones que ya tenemos y participar en proyectos relacionados con ERP, logística, gestión interna y comercio B2B.

No buscamos necesariamente a alguien que domine todas las tecnologías que utilizamos. Buscamos una persona con experiencia en desarrollo, resolutiva y con capacidad para entender un negocio real y convertir necesidades en soluciones.

**¿En qué trabajarás?**

* Desarrollo y mejora de aplicaciones internas y aplicaciones web.
* Integraciones entre nuestros diferentes sistemas, ERP, SGA y otras herramientas.
* Automatización y mejora de procesos.
* Trabajo con bases de datos y optimización de consultas y procesos.
* Evolución y modernización de aplicaciones existentes.
* Uso de herramientas de IA como apoyo al desarrollo, análisis, documentación y automatización.

**¿Qué buscamos?**

Nos interesa especialmente experiencia en algunas de estas tecnologías o entornos:

* PHP y/o Python.
* SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
* Integraciones mediante APIs.
* ERP, SGA, Odoo o aplicaciones de gestión empresarial.
* .NET.
* Progress / OpenEdge.

No es necesario dominar todo lo anterior. Valoraremos especialmente que tengas una buena base técnica, autonomía, capacidad para aprender y experiencia trabajando sobre aplicaciones reales en producción.

**El puesto** 

La idea no es desarrollar software aislado del negocio. Trabajarás directamente sobre procesos que utilizan diariamente diferentes áreas de una empresa de más de 160 personas: logística, almacén, compras, ventas, administración, e\-commerce, etc.

Tenemos muchos proyectos pendientes y buscamos alguien que pueda incorporarse al equipo, aportar experiencia y asumir progresivamente proyectos propios.

Si estás interesado/a envíanos tu currículum para que podamos contactarte y entrar en más detalle sobre las condiciones de la vacante.

Ubicación del trabajo: Empleo presencial

jobs.title: Senior Playable Ads Programmer
jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

**Role Summary:**



We're looking for a **Mid\-Senior Playable Programmer / Creative Technical Artist to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us create high\-performing playable ads and creative content for our mobile games.



This is a **fully remote position open to candidates from any location**, with availability to work in alignment with our Saudi Arabia working schedule (Sunday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM KSA time).



The role combines technical development and creative production, using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies to build, iterate, and optimize interactive playable experiences and performance\-focused video creatives.



Working closely with AI Engineering, Design, Marketing, UA, Product, Art, and Engineering, you'll be part of a fast\-paced environment where rapid experimentation, high\-volume testing, and iteration are a big part of how we work.



You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to our internal creative production and AI\-assisted tools and workflows, helping us find faster and more scalable ways to produce and test creatives.


### **Responsibilities**


**Playable Development \& Prototyping**


* Develop and maintain playable ads and gameplay prototypes using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies
* Build responsive gameplay interactions, UI flows, animations, visual feedback, and creative effects
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay and interactive creative concepts
* Build reusable gameplay systems, modular templates, components, and scalable architectures
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code where applicable
* Optimize playables for performance, loading time, file size, and cross\-device/platform compatibility


**Creative Production \& Performance**


* Create and iterate on video advertising creatives, gameplay\-based videos, and performance marketing assets
* Produce a high volume of playable and video creative variations for testing
* Iterate on creatives based on testing results, analytics, and UA performance
* Experiment with different gameplay concepts, creative formats, hooks, interactions, and technical approaches
* Support debugging, testing, analytics integrations, creative validation, and quality control


**AI, Tools \& Automation**


* Collaborate with AI Engineers on AI\-generated playable, video creative, and automation workflows
* Help develop, test, validate, and improve internal tools used for playable and creative production
* Explore AI\-assisted development and creative production workflows
* Experiment with new tools, engines, technologies, and approaches that can improve the speed and scale of creative production


**Collaboration**


* Work closely with Marketing, UA, Product, Design, Art, AI, and Engineering teams
* Translate creative concepts into technically feasible and engaging playable experiences
* Collaborate on creative testing and iteration based on performance data and learnings
* Contribute ideas and technical solutions throughout the creative development process

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building polished, responsive, and technically reliable playable ads
* Producing and iterating on playable and video creatives quickly and at high volume
* Creating reusable systems and templates that make creative production faster and more scalable
* Delivering playables that meet performance, loading time, file size, and platform requirements
* Using creative performance data and testing results to continuously improve concepts and execution
* Combining strong technical implementation with creative thinking and experimentation
* Contributing to AI\-assisted tools and workflows that improve creative production
* Collaborating effectively across creative, technical, product, and UA teams
* Taking strong ownership of creative concepts from prototype through testing and iteration

### **Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of experience in Unity game development, technical art, creative development, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Unity and C\# and/or JavaScript
* Experience building gameplay systems, prototypes, playable ads, or interactive advertising experiences
* Strong understanding of mobile optimization, performance, and technical constraints
* Ability to combine technical implementation with creative thinking and fast prototyping
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative, and performance\-driven environment

### **Bonus Points For**


* Experience with Luna Playable and playable ad platforms such as AppLovin, Unity Ads, Meta, or Google
* Experience creating playable ads, hypercasual/hybrid\-casual prototypes, or video creatives for mobile game UA
* Experience with motion graphics, animation, VFX, shaders, or technical art, using tools such as After Effects, Blender, or Unity Timeline
* Experience with AI\-assisted creative production, automation tools, or workflows
* A portfolio, GitHub, playable examples, or video creatives demonstrating relevant work


If this role excites you and you're ready to help shape the future of game development at Naphora, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer for Lab Connectivity
jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Who We Are
  
  

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action \- we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non\-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R Departments at Roche Diagnostics.
  
  

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.
  
  

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.
  
  

You will be responsible
  
  

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.
  
  

**Who you are:**  

* Healthcare Interoperability\& Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1\-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments.
* Software Development\& Quality Practices: Proven hands\-on C\# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object\-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code.
* End\-to\-End Ownership\& AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies.
* Technical Leadership\& Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders.
* Education, Communication\& Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's \+ 6 years or Master's \+ 4 years), with strong problem\-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross\-functional collaboration.


Locations
  
  

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.
  
  

Leadership Skills
  
You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.
  
  

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams usethese skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.
  
  

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:
  
  

* Put patients first
* Follow the science
* Act as one team
* Embrace differences
* Accelerate learning
* Simplify radically
* Make impact now
* Think long term


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

jobs.title: IT Integration Senior Developer
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------



El *IT Integration Senior Developer* será responsable del diseño, implementación y soporte de integraciones para las plataformas de *Broking*. Este rol trabajará estrechamente con los analistas de negocio para aplicar las soluciones definidas, garantizando la estabilidad, eficiencia y rendimiento de las integraciones actuales y futuras. Además, será clave en la identificación de mejoras y en la resolución de incidentes técnicos.

  


**Responsabilidades Principales**


**Diseño e Implementación**


* Diseñar las integraciones entre las plataformas de *brokerage* y otros sistemas existentes.
* Desarrollar y mantener los componentes personalizados en las plataformas de *brokerage*.
* Asegurar que las soluciones se construyen siguiendo patrones y buenas prácticas de desarrollo e integración.

  


**Mejora Continua**


* Proponer mejoras en integraciones y aplicaciones que contribuyan a los objetivos del negocio.
* Analizar y detectar el origen de incidentes, aplicando las soluciones correspondientes para garantizar la estabilidad operativa.

  


**Documentación y Calidad**


* Elaborar y mantener documentación técnica clara y completa.
* Realizar y supervisar pruebas integradas para asegurar un funcionamiento correcto y estable.
**Qualifications**
------------------



**Requisitos del Puesto**


**Formación y Conocimientos Técnicos**


* Conocimiento demostrable del negocio asegurador.
* Experiencia en integraciones entre aplicaciones y entornos diversos.
* Mínimo **5 años de experiencia** en:
	+ Desarrollo en plataforma **.NET**: C\#, ASP.NET, Angular, JavaScript.
	+ **SQL Server** a nivel de programación (T\-SQL).
	+ Herramientas de reporting (**Reporting Services**).
	+ Servicios de integración (**SSIS**).
  


**Competencias Profesionales**


* Capacidad para generar documentación técnica y ejecutar pruebas integradas.
* Habilidades de organización y planificación.
* Buenas habilidades de comunicación y relación interpersonal.
* **Inglés hablado y escrito a buen nivel.**
* Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

  


*We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers , from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidate.helpdesk@willistowerswatson.com.*

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
LanguageWire is a global leader in language and content services, dedicated to helping brands achieve their full global potential. Since our founding in 2000, we have continuously evolved and developed unique technology to facilitate seamless multilingual communication. Our worldwide network of language experts, coupled with an intuitive online platform, makes it effortless for brands to translate and manage multilingual content.

**The role you'll play**


We're launching a new team dedicated to modernizing and expanding one of our customer\-facing tools — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build it from the ground up. This isn't a legacy product handoff: you'll be joining at the very start, shaping both the technical direction and the team culture from day one.


The current stack is Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, but we're planning a migration to .NET in the near future. Because of this, we're looking for someone comfortable working across all three — Vue, Python, and .NET — who can help drive that transition while continuing to ship new features. As the senior engineer, you'll take a leading role in architecture decisions, technical direction, and mentoring as the team grows.

**The team you'll be a part of**


You'll be one of the founding members of a brand\-new team, led by our Tech Team Lead. We're actively growing the team and expect to bring on a Product Manager and one additional Engineer alongside you. This means you'll have real influence over how the team is structured, how we work, and the technical foundations we build on — it's a rare chance to help define a team's culture and practices from the very beginning, rather than stepping into something already set.

**If you want to make a difference, make it with us by...**

* Developing and maintaining applications, including front\-end interfaces, back\-end services, and databases
* Contributing to the architecture, design and implementation of new features and improvements
* Implementing best practices for code quality, testing and deployment automation
* Ensuring high\-quality software through active participation in code reviews
* Actively engaging in sprint retrospectives, refinements, daily stand\-ups, and other team processes
* Taking full ownership of the products and solutions you develop, eliminating bugs early in the process through TDD/BDD and other tests
* Leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and workflows to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining code quality and rigor
* Sharing knowledge and supporting fellow developers, QA professionals, and support teams
* Supporting team leaders with your expertise and assist in customer meetings
* Owning CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless operations

**In one year, you'll know you were successful if...**

* You are fully integrated as part of the team and have built strong working relationships.
* You actively contribute to maintaining a positive, collaborative, and knowledge\-sharing team atmosphere.
* You take full ownership of products and solutions, having delivered several major features to production with measurable impact.
* You share your expertise by mentoring mid\-level and junior developers, helping them grow and succeed.
* You contribute to improving team processes, code quality, and technical decision\-making.

**Desired Experience And Competencies**

**What does it take to work for LanguageWire?**

**What you'll need to bring**

* Motivational and engaging with a "can do" attitude, fostering a positive team environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices.
* Extensive experience with C\# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET 6\+, ASP.NET Web API, etc.)
* Experience with Python
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration
* Familiarity with asynchronous programming and performance optimization in .NET
* Responsible for front\-end codebases using Vue.js and/or TypeScript, collaborating closely with full\-stack and frontend developers
* Sound understanding of frontend build tools and state management (Vuex, Pinia, or similar).
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices
* Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end).
* Comfortable working in agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and peer mentoring
* Ability to collaborate effectively in cross\-functional teams, including product, design, and QA.
* DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, etc.), Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

**This will make you stand out**

* Knowledge of microservices architecture and event\-driven systems
* Proficiency with relational databases, particularly MSSQL and/or PostgreSQL
* Hands\-on experience with Entity Framework (EF Core) and LINQ
* Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus)
* Strong focus on testing practices (unit testing, integration testing, test automation)
* Awareness of security best practices in software development
* Ability to mentor others and foster knowledge\-sharing within the team

**Our perks**

* Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas
* Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture
* International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kiev, Gdansk, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia
* We take care of our people and initiate many social get\-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!
* 150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments
* Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square
* Private health insurance
* We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.
* Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities
* A dog friendly atmosphere
* Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.
* Social area and game room (foosball table, darts, and board games)
* Bike and car parking

  



**About LanguageWire**
At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people \& businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.  



**Our values drive our behavior**

**We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.**

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don’t understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We care and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback, and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.

  



**Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:**


"Once the purpose \& values project had been rolled out, I felt a stronger connection and more engaged. Within our team, we care for each other, help each other on tasks, projects and we value different opinions. We truly lift each other up to be our best and ambitiously strive towards constantly improving on a professional and personal level."


(Arpi, Application Support Team Lead, Valencia)

  



**Yes, to diversity, equity \& inclusion**

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.


LanguageWire’s recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.

  



Want to know more?


We can’t wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!


If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our *website!*

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer (IR-551)
jobs.description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007\. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe.We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid\-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley\-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net/


We are developing a modern ERP platform designed to digitize end\-to\-end communication and operational workflows across the dental healthcare sector. The solution connects clinical practices with specialized service providers, streamlining order tracking, custom product fulfillment, and secure digital asset exchange.


As a Senior Java Developer, you will lead backend engineering efforts to build scalable, high\-availability services that manage dynamic workflow states, business\-critical integrations, and high\-volume transaction data.

 **Requirements**  

* 5\+ Years of Experience: Solid background in core backend software development using Java (11/17\+).
* Spring Ecosystem Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Spring Web.
* Relational Databases: Strong relational data modeling and SQL performance tuning skills (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
* API Design \& Security: Proven ability to build RESTful APIs, manage OAuth2/JWT authentication, and design clean interface contracts.
* Architectural Foundations: Experience with microservices, domain\-driven design concepts, and transactional state management.
* Testing \& CI/CD: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and containerization tools (Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

**Nice\-to\-have:**

* Healthcare / MedTech Exposure: General familiarity with health\-tech software requirements, data privacy standards, or digital medical record workflows.
* Asynchronous Messaging: Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka or RabbitMQ for asynchronous processing.
* Cloud \& Large File Management: Familiarity with AWS/GCP.
* Caching \& Search: Hands\-on experience with Redis, Elasticsearch, or distributed caching systems.
* Monitoring \& Observability: Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, or central logging tools (ELK stack) for microservice monitoring.

**Responsibilities:**

* Backend Architecture: Architect, implement, and maintain scalable architecture and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring.
* Workflow Engine Design: Engineer reliable backend services to manage multi\-step business logic, status lifecycles, and event\-driven notifications.
* Integration \& Security: Design secure interfaces to connect internal modules with external systems, ensuring strict adherence to healthcare data privacy principles.
* Performance \& Data Storage: Optimize relational database schemas and query performance.
* Code Quality \& Leadership: Enforce software engineering best practices through code reviews, automated testing (unit/integration), and technical mentoring.

  

**Benefits**  

* Awesome projects with an impact
* Udemy courses of your choice

**Global Ownership:** Embrace the You build it, you run it philosophy, caring for the product as a whole rather than just your individual tickets.

**Code Quality:** Provide value through conscientious analysis and Pull Request Reviews to maintain a clean codebase.
  
**Agile Collaboration:** Work in cross\-functional teams, collaborating closely with developers, designers, data analysts, QA engineers, tech leads, product managers and product owners
  
**Mobile App Syncing:** Coordinate exact API and payload contract boundaries with React Native feature teams.
  
  

**Your profile:**  

**Seniority in .NET:** Proven experience in object\-oriented software development with deep knowledge of the .NET ecosystem (.NET 6 or above).
  
**Cloud Infrastructure:** Proven experience in Cloud development (GCP is a plus) and managing workloads in Kubernetes.
  
**Microservices:** Advanced knowledge of distributed architectures and message brokers like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  
**Database Expertise:** Proven experience with MongoDB (NoSQL) and SQL databases.
  
**Testing CI/CD:** Strong habit of creating Unit and Integration tests and managing CI/CD pipelines.
  
**Observability:** Experience with open telemetry, prometheus and grafana.
  
**Languages:** Proficiency in English is required to engage in technical discussions.
  
5\+ years of experience as a .NET Developer.
  
**Telco Domain Knowledge:** Previous engineering experience within an MVNO / MVNE will be a plus
  
**The following skills would be a plus:** Experience in DDD, vertical slicing architecture, MongoDB, Typescript, React

2️⃣ Key responsibilities
  

3️⃣ Profiles \& Skills
  

4️⃣ Why join BNP Paribas?  




**ABOUT THE JOB**
-----------------


As a Full Stack Developer, you will design and maintain responsive web applications to support operational security solutions. You will work within our Production Security service to ensure the efficient control of network, server, and endpoint infrastructures.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------


* Design and develop responsive web applications using HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
* Implement UI components, state management, and routing while ensuring accessibility (WCAG).
* Integrate RESTful or GraphQL APIs by collaborating with back\-end teams to define technical contracts.
* Write clean, testable code and participate in regular code reviews.
* Contribute to back\-end services using .NET Core or other stacks when required.
* Mentor junior developers and share front\-end best practices within the team.

**PROFILE \& SKILLS**
---------------------


**Education \& Experience**


* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field.
* You have at least 3 years of professional experience in front\-end development.

**Technical Skills**


* You are proficient in at least one major front\-end framework, preferably React.
* You have a strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript, ES6\+, and modern build tools.
* You have a solid understanding of HTML5 semantics and CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, Sass/Less).

* You can write unit and integration tests using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.

* You have strong problem\-solving skills and high attention to detail.
* You demonstrate effective communication and teamwork abilities.

**️**
-----


**WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS?**

We are BNP Paribas, a leading international bank present in 64 countries. We support our clients through financing, investment, savings, and insurance services, maintaining key positions in Corporate \& Institutional Banking.

* Opportunities for professional development.
* Flexible working arrangements.
* International and multicultural work environment.

https://group.bnpparibas/en/our\-commitments/inclusion/diversity\-equality\-and\-inclusion
